items.en: The more we read, the more we know.
items.hint: the more...the more

items.cn: 长江是中国最长的河流之一。
items.en: The Yangtze River is one of the longest rivers in China.
items.hint: one of + 最高级 + 复数名词

items.cn: 这间教室是那间的两倍大。
items.en: This classroom is twice as large as that one.
items.hint: 倍数 + as...as

items.en: It is much warmer today than yesterday.
items.hint: much 修饰比较级

items.cn: 请在字典里查这个新词。
items.en: Please look up the new word in the dictionary.
items.hint: look up 查阅

items.cn: 我们应该关掉不用的电灯。
items.en: We should turn off lights that are not in use.
items.hint: turn off 关闭

items.cn: 她主动提出照顾邻居的孩子。
items.en: She offered to look after her neighbour's child.
items.hint: look after 照顾

items.cn: 会议因为暴雨被推迟了。
items.en: The meeting was put off because of the heavy rain.
items.hint: put off 推迟

items.cn: 请准时到达，不要让大家等。
items.en: Please arrive on time and do not keep everyone waiting.
items.hint: on time 准时

items.cn: 许多学生参加了社区服务。
items.en: Many students took part in community service.
items.hint: take part in 参加

items.cn: 除了英语，她还学习法语。
items.en: She studies French as well as English.
items.hint: as well as 以及

items.cn: 一方面骑车环保，另一方面还能锻炼。
items.en: On the one hand, cycling is green; on the other hand, it is good exercise.
items.hint: on the one hand...on the other hand

items.cn: 这台机器是去年制造的。
items.en: This machine was made last year.
items.hint: 一般过去时被动

items.cn: 这些教室每天都被打扫。
items.en: These classrooms are cleaned every day.
items.hint: 一般现在时被动

items.cn: 比赛结果将在下午公布。
items.en: The result will be announced in the afternoon.
items.hint: 一般将来时被动

items.cn: 这个问题必须马上解决。
items.en: This problem must be solved at once.
items.hint: 情态动词被动

items.en: Tom is friendly, isn't he?
items.hint: 前肯后否

items.en: You did not forget your homework, did you?
items.hint: 前否后肯

items.en: Let us go for a walk, shall we?
items.hint: Let's 的附加问句

items.cn: 独自解决这个问题对他来说很难。
items.en: It is difficult for him to solve the problem by himself.
items.hint: it 作形式主语

items.cn: 我发现每天复习很有帮助。
items.en: I find it helpful to review every day.
items.hint: it 作形式宾语

items.cn: 从我家到学校大约两公里。
items.en: It is about two kilometres from my home to school.
items.hint: it 表示距离

items.cn: 你能告诉我怎样去科技馆吗？
items.en: Can you tell me how to get to the science museum?
items.hint: 疑问词 + to do

items.cn: 我们认识彼此已经三年了。
items.en: We have known each other for three years.
items.hint: for + 时间段用现在完成时

items.cn: 她刚刚把借来的书还给图书馆。
items.en: She has just returned the borrowed book to the library.
items.hint: just 用现在完成时

items.cn: 当警报响起时，我们正在做实验。
items.en: We were doing an experiment when the alarm rang.
items.hint: 过去进行时 + when

items.cn: 暑假期间我打算参加游泳课程。
items.en: I am going to take a swimming course during the summer holiday.
items.hint: 打算用 be going to

items.en: This letter is written in English.
items.hint: 一般现在时被动

items.cn: 除非你亲自尝试，否则不会知道结果。
items.en: You will not know the result unless you try it yourself.
items.hint: unless 引导条件

items.cn: 我们需要想出一个更环保的办法。
items.en: We need to come up with a greener solution.
items.hint: come up with 想出

items.cn: 我想知道他为什么拒绝了邀请。
items.en: I wonder why he refused the invitation.
items.hint: 宾语从句用陈述语序

items.cn: 老师问我们是否理解这条规则。
items.en: The teacher asked whether we understood the rule.
items.hint: whether 引导宾语从句

items.cn: 请告诉我下一班车什么时候到。
items.en: Please tell me when the next bus will arrive.
items.hint: 疑问词后用陈述语序

items.cn: 我相信我们的努力会带来改变。
items.en: I believe that our efforts will make a difference.
items.hint: that 引导宾语从句

items.cn: 她说她已经完成了实验。
items.en: She said that she had already finished the experiment.
items.hint: 主句过去时，先完成用过去完成时

items.cn: 正在门口等候的男孩是我弟弟。
items.en: The boy who is waiting at the door is my brother.
items.hint: who 引导定语从句

items.cn: 这是帮助我养成阅读习惯的老师。
items.en: This is the teacher who helped me develop a reading habit.
items.hint: 先行词是人用 who

items.cn: 我找到了昨天丢失的钥匙。
items.en: I found the key that I lost yesterday.
items.hint: that 指代物

items.cn: 我们参观了屋顶是绿色的房子。
items.en: We visited the house whose roof is green.
items.hint: whose 表示所属

items.cn: 这是我读过的最有价值的书。
items.en: This is the most valuable book that I have ever read.
items.hint: 最高级后的定语从句常用 that

items.cn: 虽然失败了几次，她仍然继续尝试。
items.en: Although she failed several times, she kept trying.
items.hint: although 引导让步

items.cn: 只要我们合理安排时间，就能完成任务。
items.en: As long as we manage our time well, we can finish the task.
items.hint: as long as 引导条件

items.cn: 他讲得如此清楚，以至于每个人都听懂了。
items.en: He spoke so clearly that everyone understood him.
items.hint: so...that 引导结果

items.cn: 在做决定之前，你应该认真考虑。
items.en: You should think carefully before you make a decision.
items.hint: before 引导时间状语从句

items.cn: 无论遇到什么困难，我们都不应该放弃。
items.en: Whatever difficulty we meet, we should not give up.
items.hint: whatever 引导让步

items.cn: 他所说的话使我们深受鼓舞。
items.en: What he said encouraged us greatly.
items.hint: what 引导主语从句

items.cn: 我们是否能按时到达还不确定。
items.en: Whether we can arrive on time is still uncertain.
items.hint: whether 引导主语从句

items.cn: 每个人都知道地球绕太阳转，这是事实。
items.en: That the earth moves around the sun is a fact known to everyone.
items.hint: that 引导主语从句

items.cn: 问题是我们怎样减少塑料垃圾。
items.en: The question is how we can reduce plastic waste.
items.hint: how 引导表语从句

items.cn: 事实是这项计划需要更多时间。
items.en: The fact is that the plan needs more time.
items.hint: that 引导表语从句

items.cn: 那就是我没有及时回复的原因。
items.en: That is why I did not reply in time.
items.hint: why 引导表语从句

items.cn: 在我们到达之前，演出已经开始了。
items.en: The show had started before we arrived.
items.hint: 先发生的动作用过去完成时

items.cn: 她发现自己把笔记本忘在家里了。
items.en: She found that she had left her notebook at home.
items.hint: 遗忘发生在发现之前

items.cn: 他告诉我第二天会公布结果。
items.en: He told me that the result would be announced the next day.
items.hint: 过去将来时的被动

items.cn: 我们不知道会议是否会推迟。
items.en: We did not know whether the meeting would be put off.
items.hint: 过去将来时 + 被动

items.cn: 所有申请必须在周五前提交。
items.en: All applications must be submitted before Friday.
items.hint: 情态动词被动

items.cn: 这座古桥已经被很好地保护起来。
items.en: The ancient bridge has been well protected.
items.hint: 现在完成时被动

items.cn: 新的体育馆正在我们学校建设。
items.en: A new gym is being built at our school.
items.hint: 现在进行时被动

items.cn: 如果人人都节约用水，情况就会改善。
items.en: If everyone saves water, the situation will improve.
items.hint: 真实条件句主将从现

items.cn: 如果我是队长，我会先听取每个人的意见。
items.en: If I were the captain, I would listen to everyone's opinion first.
items.hint: 与现在事实相反

items.cn: 我不确定他是否已经收到通知。
items.en: I am not sure whether he has received the notice.
items.hint: whether 引导宾语从句

items.cn: 昨天获奖的女孩来自我们学校。
items.en: The girl who won the prize yesterday comes from our school.
items.hint: who 引导定语从句

items.cn: 我们真正需要的是一个清晰的计划。
items.en: What we really need is a clear plan.
items.hint: what 引导主语从句

items.cn: 我的担心是天气可能突然变化。
items.en: My worry is that the weather may change suddenly.
items.hint: that 引导表语从句

items.cn: 到下个月，这项工程将全部完成。
items.en: The project will have been completed by next month.
items.hint: 将来完成时被动

items.cn: 如果你当时听了建议，就不会犯这个错误。
items.en: If you had followed the advice, you would not have made this mistake.
items.hint: 与过去事实相反

items.cn: 老师提醒我们第二天要带实验报告。
items.en: The teacher reminded us that we should bring the experiment report the next day.
items.hint: 转述中的时间变化

items.cn: 昨天这个时候，学生们正在音乐教室里唱歌。
items.en: The students were singing in the music room at this time yesterday.
items.hint: at this time yesterday 用过去进行时 was/were doing

items.cn: 昨晚九点她正在做作业。
items.en: She was doing her homework at nine o'clock last night.
items.hint: 过去某一时刻正在进行的动作用过去进行时

items.cn: 老师进来的时候，他们正在下棋。
items.en: They were playing chess when the teacher came in.
items.hint: when 从句用短暂动作，主句用过去进行时

items.cn: 爸爸做饭的时候，我正在打扫房间。
items.en: While Dad was cooking, I was cleaning the room.
items.hint: while 后接延续性动作，两个动作都用过去进行时

items.en: She has never been to Beijing, has she?
items.hint: 前否后肯：never 是否定词，疑问部分用肯定

items.en: There will be a sports meeting next week, won't there?
items.hint: there will be 的反意疑问部分用 won't there

items.cn: 看那些乌云，天要下大雨了。
items.en: Look at those black clouds. It is going to rain heavily.
items.hint: 有迹象的预测用 be going to

items.cn: 如果明天天气好，我们就要去野餐。
items.en: We are going to have a picnic if the weather is fine tomorrow.
items.hint: be going to 表计划；if 从句用一般现在时

items.en: I have already finished my homework.
items.hint: already 常与现在完成时连用，放在 have 之后

items.en: Have you ever tried Chinese food?
items.hint: ever 询问经历，用现在完成时

items.cn: 她从 2020 年起就住在这里。
items.en: She has lived here since 2020.
items.hint: since + 过去时间点，谓语用现在完成时

items.en: English is spoken in many countries.
items.hint: 一般现在时被动 am/is/are + 过去分词

items.cn: 昨天学生们打扫了教室。
items.en: The classroom was cleaned by the students yesterday.
items.hint: 一般过去时被动 was/were + 过去分词

items.cn: 河边的树已经被种下了。
items.en: The trees have been planted along the river.
items.hint: 现在完成时被动 have/has been + 过去分词

items.cn: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。
items.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
items.hint: 主将从现：if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will

items.cn: 如果你认真复习，就能通过考试。
items.en: You will pass the exam if you review carefully.
items.hint: 主将从现：if 从句用一般现在时

items.cn: 你必须先完成作业才能看电视。
items.en: You must finish your homework before you watch TV.
items.hint: must + 动词原形；before 引导时间状语从句

items.cn: 如果你不知道单词的意思，可以在字典里查。
items.en: You can look up the word in the dictionary if you don't know its meaning.
items.hint: look up 查阅；if 条件句

items.en: There are some birds singing in the tree.
items.hint: There be 句型，singing 作定语修饰 birds

items.cn: 她因为生病没有去上学。
items.en: She didn't go to school because she was ill.
items.hint: 一般过去时否定 didn't + 动词原形；because 引导原因从句

items.cn: 今年的考试比去年难多了。
items.en: This year's test is much harder than last year's.
items.hint: much 修饰比较级表示程度

items.cn: 在所有学生中，汤姆跑得最快。
items.en: Of all the students, Tom runs the fastest.
items.hint: of all + 最高级表示范围

items.en: He is not only smart but also hardworking.
items.hint: not only...but also... 不但……而且……

items.en: The harder you work, the better your grades will be.
items.hint: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 表示越……越……

items.cn: 昨天晚上八点，李明正在房间里完成他的科学作业。
items.en: Li Ming was finishing his science homework in his room at eight o'clock last night.
items.hint: 过去某个具体时间正在发生的动作，用过去进行时 was/were doing。

items.cn: 当妈妈回家时，孩子们正在看一部关于动物的电影。
items.en: The children were watching a movie about animals when their mother came home.
items.hint: when 引导时间状语从句，主句常用过去进行时表示正在发生的动作。

items.cn: 我们的教室每天早晨都被学生们打扫得很干净。
items.en: Our classroom is kept clean by the students every morning.
items.hint: 一般现在时被动语态结构为 am/is/are + 过去分词。

items.cn: 你曾经参加过学校的英语演讲比赛吗？
items.en: Have you ever taken part in the school's English speech competition?
items.hint: ever 常用于现在完成时疑问句，表示曾经有过某种经历。

items.cn: 我的朋友已经学习英语五年了。
items.en: My friend has learned English for five years.
items.hint: for + 一段时间表示持续时间，常与现在完成时连用。

items.cn: 前面堵车了，我们要迟到了。
items.en: There is a traffic jam ahead. We are going to be late.
items.hint: 根据明显迹象预测，用 be going to。

items.cn: 如果你每天练习英语，你会取得更大的进步。
items.en: If you practice English every day, you will make greater progress.
items.hint: if 条件句表示将来时，主句用 will，从句用一般现在时。

items.cn: 你昨天没有完成你的数学作业，对吗？
items.en: You didn't finish your math homework yesterday, did you?
items.hint: 前否后肯构成反意疑问句。

items.cn: 这个城市不像那个城市一样繁忙。
items.en: This city is not as busy as that one.
items.hint: not as...as 表示“不如……一样”。

items.cn: 她正在字典里查生词的意思。
items.en: She is looking up the meaning of the new word in the dictionary.
items.hint: look up 表示查阅；现在进行时表示正在做。

items.en: Homework must be handed in on time.
items.hint: 情态动词被动结构为 must be + 过去分词。

items.cn: 我喜欢那本讲述中国历史的书。
items.en: I like the book that tells the history of China.
items.hint: that 引导定语从句，修饰前面的名词。

items.cn: 我已经学习英语八年了。
items.en: I have learned English for eight years.
items.hint: for+时间段表示持续多久，常与现在完成时连用。

items.cn: 她自从去年以来一直住在这个城市。
items.en: She has lived in this city since last year.
items.hint: since+过去时间点表示从过去一直持续到现在。

items.cn: 我刚刚完成了我的英语报告。
items.en: I have just finished my English report.
items.hint: just表示刚刚发生的动作，常用于现在完成时。

items.cn: 你还没有完成你的家庭作业吗？
items.en: Haven't you finished your homework yet?
items.hint: yet常用于否定句和疑问句，表示还、尚未。

items.cn: 我正在看书时电话响了。
items.en: I was reading a book when the phone rang.
items.hint: when 连接两个过去动作，较长动作用过去进行时。

items.cn: 老师讲解的时候，学生们正在做笔记。
items.en: While the teacher was explaining, the students were taking notes.
items.hint: while 后常接进行中的动作。

items.cn: 这些树每年春天都被种植。
items.en: These trees are planted every spring.
items.hint: 一般现在时被动结构：am/is/are+过去分词。

items.cn: 学生必须被允许表达自己的想法。
items.en: Students must be allowed to express their ideas.
items.hint: 情态动词被动：情态动词+be+过去分词。

items.cn: 那座老房子上个月被重新修建了。
items.en: The old house was rebuilt last month.
items.hint: 过去发生的被动动作使用 was/were + 过去分词。

items.cn: 如果你不抓紧时间，就会错过火车。
items.en: If you don't hurry, you will miss the train.
items.hint: if 条件句表示将来，从句用一般现在时。

items.cn: 除非你努力学习，否则你不会通过考试。
items.en: You will not pass the exam unless you study hard.
items.hint: unless等于if...not，表示除非。

items.cn: 我每天花两个小时读英语。
items.en: I spend two hours reading English every day.
items.hint: spend+时间+doing表示花时间做某事。

items.cn: 运动会已经被推迟到下周五了。
items.en: The sports meeting has been put off until next Friday.
items.hint: put off 表示推迟；现在完成时被动 have/has been + 过去分词。

items.cn: 我的书包和你的书包一样重。
items.en: My schoolbag is as heavy as yours.
items.hint: as+形容词原级+as表示一样……。

items.en: English is not as difficult as math.
items.hint: not as...as表示不如……。

items.cn: 我们越早开始，就能越早完成。
items.en: The sooner we start, the sooner we will finish.
items.hint: the + 比较级，the + 比较级 表示越……越……。

items.cn: 长城是中国最著名的地方之一。
items.en: The Great Wall is one of the most famous places in China.
items.hint: one of+the+最高级+名词复数。

items.cn: 我的姐姐每天照顾我的小狗。
items.en: My sister looks after my little dog every day.
items.hint: look after表示照顾。

items.cn: 根据天气预报，明天要下雪。
items.en: According to the weather report, it is going to snow tomorrow.
items.hint: 根据预测/迹象用 be going to。

items.cn: 你喜欢这本英语书，不是吗？
items.en: You like this English book, don't you?
items.hint: 前肯后否构成反意疑问句。

items.cn: 你昨天没有参加篮球训练，对吗？
items.en: You didn't take part in the basketball training yesterday, did you?
items.hint: 否定句后接肯定形式的反意疑问句。

items.cn: 我们认为保护环境是必要的。
items.en: We think it necessary to protect the environment.
items.hint: think/find/consider 后常用 it 作形式宾语。

items.cn: 她认为学习一门外语很有用。
items.en: She thinks it useful to learn a foreign language.
items.hint: think/find/consider后常用it作形式宾语。

items.cn: 现在的生活比过去方便得多。
items.en: Life today is much more convenient than before.
items.hint: much修饰比较级，表示……得多。

items.en: She is smart as well as hardworking.
items.hint: as well as 表示“也、还”，连接两个并列成分。

items.cn: 我还没有看过这部电影。
items.en: I haven't watched this movie yet.
items.hint: 现在完成时否定句常用yet表示还没有。

items.cn: 他已经买了那本英语词典。
items.en: He has already bought that English dictionary.
items.hint: already常用于现在完成时肯定句。

items.cn: 我不知道他为什么迟到了。
items.en: I don't know why he was late.
items.hint: 宾语从句保持陈述语序。

items.cn: 你能告诉我你什么时候完成作业吗？
items.en: Can you tell me when you will finish your homework?
items.hint: 宾语从句疑问词后使用陈述语序。

items.cn: 我认识那个正在操场跑步的男孩。
items.en: I know the boy who is running on the playground.
items.hint: who引导定语从句修饰人。

items.cn: 她昨天告诉我的故事很有趣。
items.en: The story that she told me yesterday is very interesting.
items.hint: that 引导定语从句修饰物。

items.cn: 明天学校将会有一场足球比赛。
items.en: There will be a football match at school tomorrow.
items.hint: There will be表示将来存在某物。

items.cn: 教室里有一些学生正在讨论问题。
items.en: There are some students discussing problems in the classroom.
items.hint: There be句型表示某地存在某人或某物。

items.cn: 这些机器人可以被用来帮助学生学习。
items.en: These robots can be used to help students learn.
items.hint: 情态动词被动结构：can be + 过去分词。

items.cn: 每年都有很多游客参观这座博物馆。
items.en: The museum is visited by many tourists every year.
items.hint: 一般现在时被动表示经常发生的被动动作。

items.cn: 请打开电脑完成你的任务。
items.en: Please turn on the computer and finish your task.
items.hint: turn on表示打开电器。

items.en: Don't give up your dream.
items.hint: give up表示放弃。

items.en: Keep trying, and you will succeed.
items.hint: keep doing 表示持续做某事；祈使句+and 结构。

items.topic: 现在完成时与延续性动词
items.cn: 她已经离开家乡三年了。
items.en: She has been away from her hometown for three years.
items.hint: 延续状态用 have/has been + 形容词/副词。

items.cn: 我找不到我的钥匙，因为我把它弄丢了。
items.en: I can't find my key because I have lost it.
items.hint: 过去发生的动作对现在造成影响，用现在完成时。

items.cn: 当我到达车站时，火车已经离开了。
items.en: When I arrived at the station, the train had left.
items.hint: 过去某动作发生前已经完成，用过去完成时。

items.cn: 昨天下午三点，他们正在操场上踢足球。
items.en: They were playing football on the playground at three o'clock yesterday afternoon.
items.hint: 过去某一时刻正在进行的动作使用过去进行时。

items.cn: 他看电视的时候睡着了。
items.en: He fell asleep while he was watching TV.
items.hint: while 后接延续性动作，用过去进行时。

items.cn: 如果你不给花浇水，它们就会死。
items.en: If you don't water the flowers, they will die.
items.hint: if 条件句主将从现；条件部分用一般现在时。

items.cn: 除非天气变好，否则我们不会去野餐。
items.en: We won't go for a picnic unless the weather gets better.
items.hint: unless表示除非，后面接一般现在时。

items.en: Paper is made from wood.
items.hint: 一般现在时被动：be + 过去分词。

items.en: The flowers must be watered every day.
items.hint: 情态动词后的被动结构为 must be done。

items.cn: 我相信努力学习会帮助我实现梦想。
items.en: I believe that studying hard will help me achieve my dream.
items.hint: 宾语从句中that可以引导陈述内容。

items.cn: 我不知道他明天是否会来。
items.en: I don't know whether he will come tomorrow.
items.hint: whether 引导宾语从句，用陈述语序。

items.cn: 那个帮助我的女孩是我的同班同学。
items.en: The girl who helped me is my classmate.
items.hint: who引导定语从句修饰人。

items.cn: 新操场比旧操场大得多。
items.en: The new playground is much bigger than the old one.
items.hint: much 修饰比较级，加强比较程度。

items.cn: 你越仔细，犯的错就越少。
items.en: The more careful you are, the fewer mistakes you will make.
items.hint: the + 比较级，the + 比较级 表示越……越……。

items.cn: 上海是世界上最大的城市之一。
items.en: Shanghai is one of the largest cities in the world.
items.hint: one of + the + 最高级 + 名词复数。

items.cn: 你应该查阅这个单词的意思。
items.en: You should look up the meaning of this word.
items.hint: look up表示查阅信息。

items.en: Please look after your younger brother.
items.hint: look after表示照顾。

items.cn: 她每天花很多时间练习钢琴。
items.en: She spends a lot of time practicing the piano every day.
items.hint: spend time doing sth表示花时间做某事。

items.cn: 这个男孩既诚实又勇敢。
items.en: The boy is honest as well as brave.
items.hint: as well as 表示“也、还”，连接两个并列成分。

items.cn: 桌子上有一本老师推荐的书。
items.en: There is a book recommended by the teacher on the desk.
items.hint: There be后可接过去分词作后置定语。

items.cn: 互联网使获取信息变得容易。
items.en: The Internet makes it easy to get information.
items.hint: make it + adj + to do 结构。

items.en: The weather is cold, isn't it?
items.hint: be动词肯定句后接否定反意疑问句。

items.cn: 我到家时，妈妈已经做好晚饭了。
items.en: By the time I got home, my mother had cooked dinner.
items.hint: 先发生的动作用过去完成时 had done。

items.cn: 因为雨下得很大，我们待在家里。
items.en: We stayed at home because it was raining heavily.
items.hint: because 引导原因状语从句。

items.cn: 虽然任务很难，但是我们完成了它。
items.en: Although the task was difficult, we finished it.
items.hint: although表示虽然，不能与but同时使用。

items.cn: 我的英语老师自从我们进入初中以来一直鼓励我们阅读英文文章。
items.en: My English teacher has encouraged us to read English articles since we entered junior high school.
items.hint: since引导时间点，主句常用现在完成时表示持续到现在。

items.cn: 当我准备考试时，朋友给我打来了电话。
items.en: My friend called me when I was preparing for the exam.
items.hint: when连接过去动作，正在进行的动作使用过去进行时。

items.en: Bananas are grown in Hainan.
items.hint: 一般现在时被动：be + 过去分词。

items.cn: 学生的问题应该被认真回答。
items.en: Students' questions should be answered carefully.
items.hint: 情态动词后接被动结构：should be + 过去分词。

items.cn: 如果你每天记忆新单词，你的词汇量会增加。
items.en: If you learn new words every day, your vocabulary will increase.
items.hint: if条件句表示将来时，从句用一般现在时。

items.cn: 除非你完成作业，否则你不能出去玩。
items.en: Unless you finish your homework, you can't go out to play.
items.hint: unless 表示除非，可置于句首。

items.cn: 他花了整个下午修自行车。
items.en: He spent the whole afternoon fixing the bike.
items.hint: spend + 时间 + doing 表示花时间做某事。

items.cn: 因为下雨，我们不得不推迟旅行。
items.en: We had to put off the trip because of the rain.
items.hint: put off 表示推迟。

items.cn: 这部电影没有那本书有趣。
items.en: The movie is not as interesting as the book.
items.hint: not as...as表示不如……。

items.cn: 你越了解英语文化，就越喜欢英语。
items.en: The more you know about English culture, the more you like English.
items.hint: the+比较级，the+比较级表示越……越……。

items.cn: 她是我们班最努力的学生之一。
items.en: She is one of the hardest-working students in our class.
items.hint: one of + the + 最高级 + 名词复数。

items.cn: 我不在的时候你能帮我照顾猫吗？
items.en: Can you look after my cat while I am away?
items.hint: look after 表示照顾。

items.cn: 这个周末我们打算去参观科学博物馆。
items.en: We are going to visit the science museum this weekend.
items.hint: be going to 表示计划或打算。

items.cn: 老师刚刚告诉我们这个好消息。
items.en: The teacher has just told us the good news.
items.hint: just表示刚刚发生的动作，常用于现在完成时。

items.cn: 我们发现按时完成工作很困难。
items.en: We found it difficult to finish the work on time.
items.hint: find it + 形容词 + to do 表示发现做某事……。

items.cn: 他喜欢打篮球，也喜欢游泳。
items.en: He likes swimming as well as playing basketball.
items.hint: as well as表示也、还。

items.cn: 你的朋友昨天帮助了你，是吗？
items.en: Your friend helped you yesterday, didn't he?
items.hint: 肯定句后接否定形式反义疑问句。

items.cn: 你能告诉我她在会议上说了什么吗？
items.en: Can you tell me what she said at the meeting?
items.hint: 宾语从句使用陈述语序。

items.cn: 教我们英语的那位女士非常和蔼。
items.en: The woman who teaches us English is very kind.
items.hint: who引导定语从句修饰人。

items.cn: 下个月我们学校礼堂将有一场才艺表演。
items.en: There is going to be a talent show in our school hall next month.
items.hint: There is going to be 表示将来存在某物。

items.cn: 你读过《哈利·波特》这本书吗？
items.en: Have you ever read the book Harry Potter?
items.hint: ever常用于现在完成时疑问句，表示曾经。

items.cn: 你父母明天会来参加家长会吗？
items.en: Will your parents come to the parents' meeting tomorrow?
items.hint: will 提前构成一般疑问句。

items.cn: 他每天骑自行车去学校。
items.en: He goes to school by bike every day.
items.hint: by+交通工具表示乘坐某种交通方式。

items.cn: 这些问题将在会议上被讨论。
items.en: These problems will be discussed at the meeting.
items.hint: 一般将来时被动：will be + 过去分词。

items.cn: 虽然学习英语很困难，但是它对未来非常重要。
items.en: Although learning English is difficult, it is very important for the future.
items.hint: although引导让步状语从句，不能与but同时使用。

items.cn: 我还没有决定暑假去哪里旅行。
items.en: I haven't decided where to travel during the summer vacation yet.
items.hint: yet用于现在完成时否定句，表示尚未完成。

items.cn: 我们成为朋友已经超过五年了。
items.en: We have been friends for more than five years.
items.hint: 表示状态持续时间时，be动词用现在完成时。

items.cn: 他完成作业后就去睡觉了。
items.en: After he had finished his homework, he went to bed.
items.hint: 过去某个时间之前已经完成的动作使用过去完成时。

items.cn: 学生们考试时，老师在教室里走来走去。
items.en: While the students were doing the test, the teacher walked around the classroom.
items.hint: while后常接过去进行时表示正在进行的动作。

items.cn: 窗户昨晚被大风刮破了。
items.en: The windows were broken by the strong wind last night.
items.hint: 过去发生的被动动作使用 was/were + 过去分词。

items.cn: 这些规则必须被所有学生遵守。
items.en: These rules must be followed by all students.
items.hint: must后面的被动结构为must be done。

items.en: There are many books lying on the floor.
items.hint: There be句型表示存在，后面可接现在分词作补充说明。

items.cn: 我想知道他是否能解决这个问题。
items.en: I want to know whether he can solve this problem.
items.hint: whether引导宾语从句表示是否。

items.cn: 你知道电影几点开始吗？
items.en: Do you know what time the film starts?
items.hint: 疑问词引导宾语从句时使用陈述语序。

items.cn: 我们班唱歌最好的女孩是艾米。
items.en: The girl who sings best in our class is Amy.
items.hint: who引导定语从句修饰人。

items.cn: 爸爸送给我的那辆自行车是蓝色的。
items.en: The bike that my father gave me is blue.
items.hint: that可以引导定语从句修饰物。

items.cn: 这个红色的包比黑色的贵得多。
items.en: The red bag is much more expensive than the black one.
items.hint: much可以修饰比较级，加强程度。

items.cn: 跑得越快，你到达终点就越早。
items.en: The faster you run, the earlier you will reach the finish line.
items.hint: the+比较级，the+比较级表示越……越……。

items.cn: 大连是中国最美丽的城市之一。
items.en: Dalian is one of the most beautiful cities in China.
items.hint: one of + 最高级 + 名词复数。

items.cn: 遇到不认识的单词时，我会在网上查它。
items.en: When I meet new words, I look them up online.
items.hint: look up表示查找信息或单词。

items.cn: 即使遇到困难，他仍然坚持学习英语。
items.en: He keeps learning English even when he meets difficulties.
items.hint: keep doing表示持续做某事。

items.en: Tom doesn't like sports, does he?
items.hint: 否定意义的陈述句后接肯定形式反意疑问句。

items.cn: 对于学生来说，保持良好的学习习惯很重要。
items.en: It is important for students to keep good study habits.
items.hint: It is + 形容词 + for sb + to do 表示做某事对某人来说……。

items.en: She can play the piano as well as sing songs.
items.hint: as well as表示除了……之外还……。

items.cn: 如果我们保护环境，未来的生活会变得更美好。
items.en: If we protect the environment, life will become better in the future.
items.hint: if条件句中从句用一般现在时，主句用will。

items.cn: 昨晚十点我父母正在看电视。
items.en: My parents were watching TV at ten o'clock last night.
items.hint: 过去具体时间正在发生的动作使用过去进行时。

items.cn: 当我正在做作业时，妈妈让我帮助她。
items.en: My mother asked me to help her when I was doing my homework.
items.hint: when连接过去动作，持续动作使用过去进行时。

items.cn: 我们在公园散步时遇到了老师。
items.en: While we were walking in the park, we met our teacher.
items.hint: while后常接过去进行时表示背景动作。

items.en: They haven't arrived yet, have they?
items.hint: 前否后肯构成反义疑问句。

items.cn: 他已经完成任务了，不是吗？
items.en: He has finished the task, hasn't he?
items.hint: 肯定句后接否定形式反义疑问句。

items.cn: 他错过了公交车，所以会迟到。
items.en: He missed the bus, so he is going to be late.
items.hint: 根据现有迹象推断未来用 be going to。

items.en: Will she be free this afternoon?
items.hint: Will 开头的一般疑问句表示将来的动作。

items.en: French is taught in our school.
items.hint: 一般现在时被动结构为 am/is/are + 过去分词。

items.en: Vegetables are sold in this market every day.
items.hint: 表示客观事实的被动动作使用一般现在时。

items.cn: 你曾经听过这个英语歌曲吗？
items.en: Have you ever heard this English song?
items.hint: ever用于现在完成时疑问句表示曾经。

items.cn: 她已经在这所学校工作三年了。
items.en: She has worked at this school for three years.
items.hint: for加时间段表示持续时间。

items.cn: 从小学起我就认识他了。
items.en: I have known him since we were in primary school.
items.hint: since 后接过去时间点或时间从句。

items.en: He has just left the office.
items.hint: just表示刚刚完成的动作。

items.cn: 他还没有找到他的手机。
items.en: He hasn't found his phone yet.
items.hint: yet常用于现在完成时否定句。

items.cn: 如果你早点完成作业，就可以看电视。
items.en: If you finish your homework early, you can watch TV.
items.hint: if条件句从句用一般现在时。

items.cn: 我在网上查了那个电话号码。
items.en: I looked up the phone number on the Internet.
items.hint: look up 表示查阅单词或资料。

items.en: The room must be kept tidy.
items.hint: 情态动词被动结构为 must be done。

items.en: There will be a parent meeting next Friday.
items.hint: There will be 表示将来存在。

items.cn: 这支蓝色的笔没有红色的长。
items.en: The blue pen is not as long as the red one.
items.hint: not as...as表示不如……。

items.en: Math is much more difficult than before.
items.hint: much修饰比较级表示程度加强。

items.cn: 他认为解决这个问题很容易。
items.en: He considered it easy to solve the problem.
items.hint: consider/find/think + it + 形容词 + to do 结构。

items.cn: 我不知道他什么时候会回来。
items.en: I don't know when he will come back.
items.hint: 宾语从句使用陈述语序。

items.cn: 救了我爷爷的那位医生非常有名。
items.en: The doctor who saved my grandpa is very famous.
items.hint: who引导定语从句修饰人。

items.cn: 这是历史上最重要的发明之一。
items.en: This is one of the most important inventions in history.
items.hint: one of + 最高级 + 复数名词表示最……之一。

items.cn: 虽然在下雨，比赛仍然继续了。
items.en: Although it was raining, the match continued.
items.hint: although引导让步状语从句。

items.cn: 孔子是中国历史上最著名的老师之一。
items.en: Confucius is one of the most famous teachers in Chinese history.
items.hint: one of + 最高级 + 复数名词，常与现在完成时搭配。

items.cn: 当老师到达教室时，学生们已经开始讨论了。
items.en: When the teacher arrived at the classroom, the students had already started discussing.
items.hint: 过去某动作发生前已经完成的动作使用过去完成时。

items.cn: 这张照片是在去年学校旅行中拍摄的。
items.en: This photo was taken during the school trip last year.
items.hint: 过去发生的被动动作使用 was/were + 过去分词。

items.cn: 她已经完成了所有家庭作业，所以她可以出去玩。
items.en: She has finished all her homework, so she can go out to play.
items.hint: 现在完成时表示过去发生的动作对现在有影响。

items.cn: 如果明天下雪，我们就堆雪人。
items.en: If it snows tomorrow, we will make a snowman.
items.hint: if主将从现，从句使用一般现在时。

items.cn: 除非有充足的阳光，否则这些花长不好。
items.en: The flowers won't grow unless they get enough sunlight.
items.hint: unless相当于if...not，表示除非。

items.cn: 垃圾应该被分类处理以保护环境。
items.en: Rubbish should be separated to protect the environment.
items.hint: 情态动词后的被动形式为 should be done。

items.cn: 花园里有一些孩子在玩耍。
items.en: There are some children playing in the garden.
items.hint: There be后可接现在分词短语补充说明。

items.en: She asked me if I could help her.
items.hint: if/whether 引导宾语从句，用陈述语序。

items.cn: 你能告诉我新老师是谁吗？
items.en: Could you tell me who the new teacher is?
items.hint: 特殊疑问词引导宾语从句时不用疑问语序。

items.cn: 正在打扫教室的学生们在值日。
items.en: The students who are cleaning the classroom are on duty.
items.hint: who引导定语从句修饰人。

items.cn: 桌子上的那本词典是我哥哥的。
items.en: The dictionary that is on the desk belongs to my brother.
items.hint: that可引导定语从句修饰物。

items.cn: 他把所有的钱都花在买票上了。
items.en: He spent all his money buying the tickets.
items.hint: spend + 金钱/时间 + doing 表示花费。

items.cn: 不要把今天的工作拖到明天。
items.en: Don't put off today's work until tomorrow.
items.hint: put off 表示推迟。

items.cn: 假期里她照顾她的祖父母。
items.en: She looks after her grandparents during the holidays.
items.hint: look after 表示照顾。

items.cn: 写报告前你应该先查阅资料。
items.en: You should look up the information before you write the report.
items.hint: look up 表示查找单词或资料。

items.cn: 他既能写诗也能写故事。
items.en: He can write poems as well as stories.
items.hint: as well as 表示除了……之外还……。

items.cn: 我的新书包比旧书包轻得多。
items.en: My new schoolbag is much lighter than my old one.
items.hint: much修饰比较级表示程度加强。

items.en: The higher you climb, the farther you can see.
items.hint: the+比较级，the+比较级表示越……越……。

items.cn: 我认为帮助同学是我的责任。
items.en: I consider it my duty to help my classmates.
items.hint: consider/find/think + it + 名词/形容词 + to do 结构。

items.en: They will come tomorrow, won't they?
items.hint: 肯定句后接否定形式反义疑问句。

items.cn: 下周末我要去看望我的祖父母。
items.en: I will visit my grandparents next weekend.
items.hint: will 表示将来的计划。

items.cn: 昨天这个时候我正在和朋友聊天。
items.en: I was chatting with my friend at this time yesterday.
items.hint: at this time yesterday 对应过去进行时。

items.en: The classroom must be cleaned after class.
items.hint: must be done 表示必须被完成。

items.cn: 虽然他年纪小，但他懂很多科学知识。
items.en: Although he is young, he knows a lot about science.
items.hint: although 引导让步状语从句。

items.cn: 我从来没有去过国外，但是我希望有一天能去。
items.en: I have never been abroad, but I hope I can go there someday.
items.hint: never表示从未经历过，常用于现在完成时。

items.en: The bus has already left.
items.hint: already表示已经完成的动作，常用于现在完成时。

items.cn: 图书馆已经关闭两个星期了。
items.en: The library has been closed for two weeks.
items.hint: 表示状态持续一段时间使用 has/have been。

items.cn: 昨晚七点我们正在吃晚饭。
items.en: We were having dinner at seven o'clock yesterday evening.
items.hint: 过去某个具体时间正在发生的动作使用过去进行时。

items.cn: 朋友敲门时她正在睡觉。
items.en: She was sleeping when her friend knocked on the door.
items.hint: when连接过去动作，长动作使用过去进行时。

items.en: She sang while she was washing the dishes.
items.hint: while 后接延续性动作，用过去进行时。

items.en: The window is cleaned once a week.
items.hint: 一般现在时被动表示经常发生的被动动作。

items.cn: 这封信是我最好的朋友写的。
items.en: The letter was written by my best friend.
items.hint: 过去时间发生的被动动作使用 was/were done。

items.cn: 垃圾明天早上会被收走。
items.en: The rubbish will be collected tomorrow morning.
items.hint: 一般将来时被动结构为 will be done。

items.cn: 如果你来我家，我就给你看我的照片。
items.en: If you come to my home, I will show you my photos.
items.hint: if从句表示将来条件时使用一般现在时。

items.cn: 除非所有球员都准备好了，否则比赛不会开始。
items.en: The game won't start unless all the players are ready.
items.hint: unless表示除非，后接一般现在时。

items.cn: 我认为我们应该花更多时间阅读。
items.en: I think that we should spend more time reading.
items.hint: that引导宾语从句。

items.cn: 你知道会议什么时候开始吗？
items.en: Do you know when the meeting will start?
items.hint: 宾语从句使用陈述语序。

items.cn: 正在和我们校长说话的那个人是我爸爸。
items.en: The man who is talking to our headmaster is my father.
items.hint: who引导定语从句修饰人。

items.cn: 这是我祖父建造的房子。
items.en: This is the house that my grandfather built.
items.hint: that可以引导修饰物的定语从句。

items.en: She sings very well, doesn't she?
items.hint: 肯定句后用否定形式反义疑问句。

items.cn: 他们昨天没有迟到，是吗？
items.en: They weren't late yesterday, were they?
items.hint: 否定句后接肯定形式反义疑问句。

items.en: English is becoming more and more important.
items.hint: 比较级重复表示越来越……。

items.cn: 这个问题比我想象的更难。
items.en: This problem is more difficult than I expected.
items.hint: 比较级后接than表示比较。

items.en: She found it hard to believe the news.
items.hint: find it + 形容词 + to do 表示觉得做某事……。

items.cn: 我们需要想出一个解决问题的方法。
items.en: We need to come up with a way to solve the problem.
items.hint: come up with表示提出、想出。

items.cn: 听到这个坏消息后，她感到很失望。
items.en: She felt very disappointed after hearing the bad news.
items.hint: disappointed表示失望的。

items.cn: 虽然题目很难，但她全部答对了。
items.en: Although the questions were hard, she answered them all.
items.hint: although引导让步状语从句。

items.cn: 妈妈告诉我应该早点睡觉。
items.en: My mother told me that I should go to bed early.
items.hint: that引导宾语从句，注意时态变化。

items.cn: 如果你告诉我真相，我就会原谅你。
items.en: If you tell me the truth, I will forgive you.
items.hint: if条件句中主句使用will表示将来结果。

items.cn: 我还没有收到他的消息。
items.en: I haven't heard from him yet.
items.hint: yet常用于现在完成时否定句，表示还没有。

items.cn: 他们已经搬到新房子里住了。
items.en: They have already moved into the new house.
items.hint: already表示已经完成的动作。

items.cn: 妈妈回来之前我已经完成作业了。
items.en: I had finished my homework before my mother came back.
items.hint: 过去某动作之前已经完成用过去完成时。

items.cn: 更多树将在城市中种植。
items.en: More trees will be planted in the city.
items.hint: will be done表示一般将来时被动。

items.en: The doors must be locked when everyone leaves.
items.hint: must be done表示必须被完成。

items.cn: 如果你每个月存钱，就能买一辆新自行车。
items.en: If you save money every month, you can buy a new bike.
items.hint: if引导条件状语从句时，从句用一般现在时。

items.en: While she was talking on the phone, the baby woke up.
items.hint: while引导时间状语从句，持续动作使用过去进行时。

items.en: I was taking a shower when the lights went out.
items.hint: when连接过去动作，正在发生的动作使用过去进行时。

items.en: You haven't finished your homework, have you?
items.hint: 前面是否定含义时，反意疑问句用肯定形式。

items.cn: 你以前从没见过他，对吗？
items.en: You have never met him before, have you?
items.hint: 含never的句子是否定意义，后接肯定反意疑问句。

items.cn: 学生们期待着暑假的到来。
items.en: The students are looking forward to the coming of the summer vacation.
items.hint: look forward to后接名词或动名词。

items.en: Remember to turn off the tap after washing your hands.
items.hint: turn off 表示关闭电器或水龙头。

items.cn: 在学校里学生应该互相帮助。
items.en: Students should help each other at school.
items.hint: should表示建议，后接动词原形。

items.cn: 你能告诉我她昨天为什么缺席吗？
items.en: Could you tell me why she was absent yesterday?
items.hint: 疑问词引导宾语从句使用陈述语序。

items.cn: 住在那个村庄的人都很友好。
items.en: The people who live in that village are very friendly.
items.hint: who引导定语从句修饰人。

items.cn: 骑自行车比坐汽车更环保。
items.en: Riding a bike is more environmentally friendly than taking a car.
items.hint: 比较级用于比较两个事物。

items.cn: 这里的冬天没有北方那么冷。
items.en: Winter is not as cold here as in the north.
items.hint: not as...as表示不如……。

items.cn: 墙上挂着一张中国地图。
items.en: There is a map of China on the wall.
items.hint: There be表示某处存在某物。

items.cn: 这首歌深受年轻人的喜爱。
items.en: This song is loved by young people.
items.hint: 一般现在时被动表示经常存在的状态。

items.cn: 他们在这里已经待了两天。
items.en: They have stayed here for two days.
items.hint: for + 时间段，常与现在完成时连用。

items.cn: 他觉得了解历史很有趣。
items.en: He found it interesting to learn about history.
items.hint: it作形式宾语代替后面的不定式。

items.en: What a beautiful painting it is!

items.title: A different summer
items.passage: Last summer, my family and I (1)____ to a small village in the mountains. It was (2)____ unforgettable trip. The village was far from the city, (3)____ we had to take a bus for three hours. When we arrived, the villagers (4)____ us warmly. I was surprised to see an old man teaching children to read (5)____ a big tree. He had been a teacher for forty years. (6)____ he was over seventy, he still worked every day. 'Teaching children (7)____ me happy,' he said with a smile. I helped him clean the classroom, and he taught me (8)____ a poem. Before we left, he told me, 'The more you learn, the (9)____ you will be.' I will never forget (10)____ him.

blanks.hint: Last summer 是过去时间状语，用一般过去时。
unforgettable 以元音音素开头，用 an。
前因后果，用 so 表示“所以”。
全文是过去时，谓语用 welcomed。
在大树底下用 under the big tree。
“七十多岁了”和“仍每天工作”是让步关系，用 Although。
动名词 Teaching 作主语，谓语用单数 makes；引语中陈述一般事实。
teach sb to do sth。
the + 比较级，the + 比较级，表示“越……越……”。
forget doing 表示忘记做过的事。

items.hint: 先通读全文抓住大意（一次山村之行），再逐空判断时态、连词和固定搭配。

items.title: A teacher who changed many lives
items.passage: Zhang Guimei is a teacher in Yunnan. Many years ago, she noticed that some girls in her class suddenly (1)____ school. She found out that their families were too poor to pay for their education. Zhang was very (2)____ about it. She decided to do something. In 2008, she (3)____ the first free high school for girls in China. Life was hard at the beginning. She had many (4)____, but she never gave up. (5)____ how hard it was, she kept working. She (6)____ her own money on her students. She often says, 'I want my girls to have a (7)____ future.' Thanks to her, more than two thousand girls have (8)____ college. Her story has (9)____ many people across the country. It reminds us that even a small person can make a big (10)____.

blanks.hint: 下文说家里太穷缴不起学费，所以是“离开学校”辍学了。
-ed 形容词修饰人，表示“感到担心”。

考上/进入大学用 enter college；join 后接组织，take part in 后接活动。
“感动了很多人”用 touched。
make a big difference 是固定搭配，表示“产生很大影响”。

First, we should decide how much time we can spend (5)____ the phone every day. Second, we'd better put our phones away (6)____ we do our homework. Third, remember (7)____ the screen before you go to bed. If we use the phone in a right way, it will be a good (8)____, not a problem. (9)____ we use it well, it can really help us learn (10)____.

items.hint: 回答感谢用 My pleasure. / You're welcome. / Not at all.；Never mind. 用来安慰别人。

items.question: — I'm sorry I broke your cup. — ____ I have another one.
items.hint: 对道歉的回答用 Never mind. / It doesn't matter. / That's all right.。

items.topic: few / a few / little / a little
items.question: I have ____ money with me, so I can't buy the ticket.
items.hint: money 不可数，用 little / a little；little 表示“几乎没有”（否定含义）。

items.topic: few / a few / little / a little
items.question: There are ____ apples left. Let's go and buy some.
items.hint: apples 是可数名词复数，用 few / a few；few 表示“几乎没有”。

items.topic: have been to / have gone to
items.question: — Have you ever been to Beijing? — Yes, I ____ there twice.
items.hint: have been to 表示“去过”（人已回来）；have gone to 表示“去了”（人不在这里）。there 前不加 to。

items.topic: have been to / have gone to
items.question: — Where is Tom? — He ____ the library. He will be back soon.
items.hint: 人不在现场、去某地了，用 have / has gone to。

items.question: Our class ____ the basketball match and ____ Class Two at last.
items.hint: win 后接比赛、奖牌（win the match）；beat 后接对手人或队（beat Class Two）。

items.question: My brother ____ the army two years ago.
items.hint: join 后接组织、团体（join the army）；take part in 后接活动；attend 后接会议、婚礼等。

items.question: The old man can ____ hear us. He is almost deaf.
items.hint: hardly 意思是“几乎不”，不是 hard 的副词；can hardly hear 表示几乎听不见。

items.question: — Would you like coffee or tea? — ____ is OK. I don't mind.
items.hint: 两者中任意一个用 either，谓语动词用单数 is。

items.topic: 动词短语中代词的位置
items.question: Your clothes are dirty. Please ____ after you finish the work.
items.hint: “动词 + 副词”型短语接代词时，代词必须放中间：hang them up。

items.question: Please ____ to the teacher carefully in class.
items.hint: listen to 表示“有意识地听”；hear 表示“听见”（结果），后面不加 to。

items.question: I have ____ finished my homework. May I go out to play now?
items.hint: already 用于肯定句，表示“已经”；yet 用于否定句和疑问句。

items.question: Eating ____ junk food is bad for your health.
items.hint: too much + 不可数名词（junk food）；much too + 形容词或副词。

items.question: This coat is ____ expensive for me. I can't afford it.
items.hint: much too 修饰形容词 expensive，表示“实在太……”；too much 后接不可数名词。

items.question: Don't forget ____ the light when you leave the room.
items.hint: forget to do 表示忘记要做（事情还没做）；forget doing 表示忘记做过。

items.question: I'll never forget ____ the Great Wall for the first time with my father.
items.hint: forget doing 表示忘记做过的事；这里“第一次游长城”已经发生过，用 doing。

items.question: Remember ____ your homework to school tomorrow morning.
items.hint: remember to do 表示记着去做（还没做）；remember doing 表示记得做过。

items.question: The students are busy ____ for the coming exam.
items.hint: be busy doing sth 是固定搭配，表示忙于做某事。

items.question: I saw him ____ the classroom and turn off the lights.
items.hint: see sb do 表示看到动作的全过程（and turn off 说明看到了全过程）；see sb doing 表示看到动作正在进行。

items.question: When I passed by, I saw some children ____ football on the playground.
items.hint: 经过时看到动作正在进行，用 see sb doing。

items.question: My parents often make me ____ my room at weekends.
items.hint: make sb do sth 中不定式省去 to。

items.question: The little boy was made ____ his homework first.
items.hint: make sb do 变被动语态后，省掉的 to 要还原：be made to do。

items.question: ____ a club is a good way to make new friends.
items.hint: 动名词作主语时谓语用单数 is；动作在句中作主语，动词要变成 -ing 形式。

items.question: ____ English every day helps you make great progress.
items.hint: 动词短语放在句首作主语，要用动名词形式。

items.question: I'm looking forward to ____ from you soon.
items.hint: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后面接动名词 doing。

items.topic: be used to doing / used to do
items.question: My grandpa is used to ____ up early every morning.
items.hint: be used to doing 表示习惯于做某事（to 是介词）；used to do 表示过去常常做。

items.topic: be used to doing / used to do
items.question: My father used to ____ a walk after supper.
items.hint: used to do 表示过去常常做某事，后面接动词原形。

items.question: Would you mind ____ the window? It's a bit hot in here.
items.hint: mind doing sth 表示介意做某事，mind 后接动名词。

items.question: I enjoy ____ to music before going to bed.
items.hint: enjoy 后接动名词：enjoy doing sth。

items.question: The teacher asked us ____ the text aloud.
items.hint: ask sb to do sth 是常见搭配，用不定式作宾补。

items.topic: It's + adj + for sb to do
items.question: It's important for us ____ the environment.
items.hint: It's + 形容词 + for sb + to do sth 是固定句型。

items.question: The box is too heavy for the little boy ____.
items.hint: too + 形容词 + to do 表示太……以致不能……。

items.question: I can't help ____ when I watch that funny video.
items.hint: can't help doing sth 表示忍不住做某事。

items.question: He practises ____ English aloud every morning.
items.hint: practise 后接动名词：practise doing sth。

items.question: Thank you for ____ me with my English.
items.hint: 介词 for 后面要接动名词 helping。

items.question: My little sister is afraid of ____ alone at home.
items.hint: be afraid of 中 of 是介词，后接动名词。

items.question: — Would you like ____ a cup of tea? — Yes, please.
items.hint: would like to do sth 表示想要做某事。

items.question: My mother often tells me ____ too much junk food.
items.hint: tell sb not to do sth 的否定形式是在 to 前加 not。

items.question: Do you know how ____ this new machine?
items.hint: 疑问词 how / what / where + to do 可作宾语。

items.question: Why not ____ to the park this Sunday?
items.hint: Why not do sth? 是提建议的句型，后面接动词原形。

items.question: You'd better ____ your parents about the school trip.
items.hint: had better do sth 后面接动词原形。

items.hint: book /bʊk/、good /ɡʊd/、foot /fʊt/ 中 oo 读短音 /ʊ/；goose 读 /ɡuːs/。

items.question: 找出划线字母组合 oo 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: wood /wʊd/ 中 oo 读短音 /ʊ/；room、school、noon 读长音 /uː/。

items.question: 找出划线字母组合 ear 发音与其他三项不同的一项：

items.question: 找出划线字母 y 发音与其他三项不同的一项：

items.question: 找出划线字母 y 发音与其他三项不同的一项：

items.question: 找出划线字母 a 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: have /hæv/ 是例外，a 读 /æ/；name、cake、late 是开音节，a 读 /eɪ/。

items.question: 找出划线字母 a 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: agree 中第一个 a 在非重读音节里读 /ə/；cat、map、hand 读 /æ/。

items.question: 找出划线字母组合 ea 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: bread /bred/ 中 ea 读 /e/；tea、sea、mean 中 ea 读 /iː/。

items.question: 找出划线字母组合 ea 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: head、bread、ready 中 ea 读 /e/；team /tiːm/ 中 ea 读 /iː/。

items.question: 找出划线字母组合 ea 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: great /ɡreɪt/ 中 ea 读 /eɪ/，是特例；eat、meat、cheap 中 ea 读 /iː/。

items.question: 找出划线字母组合 th 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: three、think、thank 中 th 读清辅音 /θ/；this 读浊辅音 /ð/。代词/冠词里的 th 多为 /ð/。

items.question: 找出划线字母组合 th 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: month /mʌnθ/ 中 th 读 /θ/；mother、brother、weather 中 th 读 /ð/。

items.question: 找出划线字母组合 ou 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: country /ˈkʌntri/ 中 ou 读 /ʌ/；house、about、loudly 中 ou 读 /aʊ/。

items.question: 找出划线字母组合 ow 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: slow /sləʊ/ 中 ow 读 /əʊ/；now、how、brown 中 ow 读 /aʊ/。

items.question: 找出划线字母 i 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: big /bɪɡ/ 是重读闭音节，i 读 /ɪ/；bike、nice、rice 是开音节，i 读 /aɪ/。

items.question: 找出划线字母 i 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: list /lɪst/ 中 i 读 /ɪ/；line、wide、smile 中 i 读 /aɪ/。

items.question: 找出划线字母 u 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: music /ˈmjuːzɪk/ 中 u 读 /juː/；but、cup、lunch 是重读闭音节，u 读 /ʌ/。

items.question: 找出划线字母 u 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: busy /ˈbɪzi/ 中 u 读 /ɪ/，属特例；put、full、push 中 u 读 /ʊ/。

items.question: 找出划线字母 o 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: home /həʊm/ 是开音节，o 读 /əʊ/；come、son、love 中 o 读 /ʌ/。

items.question: 找出划线字母 o 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: open /ˈəʊpən/ 中 o 读 /əʊ/；dog、box、hot 是重读闭音节，o 读 /ɒ/。

items.question: 找出划线部分 -ed 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: 以 t/d 结尾的动词加 -ed 读 /ɪd/（wanted、needed、started）；played 中 -ed 读 /d/。

items.question: 找出划线部分 -ed 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: visited 以 t 结尾，-ed 读 /ɪd/；called、moved、opened 中 -ed 读 /d/。

items.question: His grandfather ____ (die) three years ago, but he still misses him.
items.hint: three years ago 是一般过去时的时间状语，谓语要用动词过去式 died。

items.question: We were all sad at the ____ (die) of our old dog.
items.hint: the 后面需要名词，die 的名词形式是 death（死亡）。

items.question: The little bird is ____ (die). We must take it to the vet at once.
items.hint: is + 现在分词构成现在进行时，表示“正在死去/奄奄一息”，用 dying。

items.question: My cat has been ____ (die) for two hours. I miss her so much.
items.hint: for + 时间段表示持续状态，要用延续性的形容词 dead（死的），不能用短暂动词 died。

items.question: The film was so ____ (bore) that I fell asleep in the cinema.
items.hint: -ing 形容词修饰物（The film is boring）；-ed 形容词修饰人（I am bored）。

items.question: We were all ____ (bore) with the same old story.
items.hint: 句子的主语是人 we，表示“感到无聊”，用 -ed 形容词 bored。

items.question: The ____ (excite) news made everyone jump with joy.
items.hint: news 是“令人激动的”，用 -ing 形容词 exciting 修饰物。

items.question: The children were ____ (excite) about the coming school trip.
items.hint: 主语是人 children，表示“感到兴奋”，用 excited。

items.question: We were ____ (surprise) to hear the good news.
items.hint: 人是“感到惊讶的”，用 surprised；事是“令人惊讶的”，用 surprising。

items.question: The result of the match was really ____ (surprise).
items.hint: 主语 the result 是事物，用 -ing 形容词 surprising。

items.question: Three ____ (thousand) students took part in the activity last week.
items.hint: 前面有具体数字 three 时，thousand 不加 s，也不加 of。

items.question: ____ (thousand) of visitors come to the Great Wall every year.
items.hint: 表示“成千上万”用 thousands of；空后已有 of，所以只填 Thousands。

items.question: ____ (luck), he caught the last bus and got home safely.
items.hint: 放句首并用逗号隔开，修饰整个句子，要用副词 Luckily（幸运的是）。

items.question: He is very ____ (luck) to have such a kind teacher.
items.hint: be 动词后接形容词作表语，句意是“幸运的”，用 lucky。

items.question: Please read the passage ____ (care) and then answer the questions.
items.hint: 修饰动词 read，要用副词 carefully。

items.question: He is a very ____ (care) driver and has never had an accident.
items.hint: 修饰名词 driver，用形容词 careful。

items.question: Don't be so ____ (care). You left your homework at home again.
items.hint: be 动词后接形容词；句意是“粗心的”，用 careless。

items.question: There are many ____ (different) between the two pictures.
items.hint: many 后接可数名词复数，different 的名词形式是 differences。

items.question: The two brothers look ____ (different), but they are twins.
items.hint: look 是系动词，后接形容词 different 作表语。

items.question: Her ____ (decide) to study abroad surprised us all.
items.hint: 形容词性物主代词 Her 后接名词，decide 的名词是 decision。

items.question: The ____ (protect) of wild animals is very important.
items.hint: the ... of 结构中间要用名词，protect 的名词是 protection。

items.question: You should eat ____ (health) and take more exercise.
items.hint: 修饰动词 eat，要用副词 healthily（健康地）。

items.question: The traffic in our city is much ____ (noise) than before.
items.hint: than 前要用比较级；noisy 变比较级是 noisier（y 变 i 加 er）。much 修饰比较级。

items.question: He is a famous ____ (music) and plays the violin very well.
items.hint: 表示“音乐家”要用表示人的名词 musician。

items.question: It's ____ (danger) to swim in the river alone.
items.hint: It's + 形容词 + to do 句型，用形容词 dangerous。

items.question: The Spring Festival is a ____ (tradition) festival in China.
items.hint: 修饰名词 festival，用形容词 traditional。

items.question: Alice is one of the most popular ____ (sing) in our school.
items.hint: one of the most popular + 名词复数，表示“最受欢迎的……之一”。

items.question: I am very ____ (interest) in Chinese history.
items.hint: be interested in sth 表示“对……感兴趣”，主语是人用 interested。

items.question: This is a very ____ (interest) book about space.
items.hint: 修饰物 book，用 -ing 形容词 interesting。

items.title: A New Seat in Class
items.passage: On the first day of school, a new student named Lily came to our class. She looked a little (1)____, so I smiled at her and asked her to sit next to me. At first, we did not know what to (2)____ about. Then I noticed a book in her hand. It was a story about animals. We soon found that we (3)____ the same hobby: reading. During the break, we went to the library (4)____. Lily said the library was much (5)____ than the one in her old school. From that day on, we often (6)____ books with each other. Last week, Lily told me that she no longer felt (7)____ in our class. Good friends can make a new place feel (8)____ a second home. I am glad that a simple (9)____ changed both of our school days. Now I always remember to be (10)____ to new classmates.

blanks.hint: 新同学初来班级，神情紧张。
talk about sth 表示谈论某事。
全文叙述过去经历，用一般过去时。
两人一起去了图书馆。
than 前用 big 的比较级 bigger。
From that day on 后继续叙述过去。
feel lonely 表示感到孤独。
feel like 表示感觉像。
前文提到作者向 Lily 微笑。
be friendly to 表示对某人友好。

items.hint: 先抓住新同学逐渐融入班级的主线，再结合时间和上下文判断。

items.title: The Lost Library Book
items.passage: Ben borrowed a library book on Monday. He planned to (1)____ it on Friday, but he could not find it on Thursday evening. He looked (2)____ his desk, his school bag and even under his bed. There was no book. Ben felt (3)____ because the library would close soon. His sister suggested looking in the car. Ben ran outside and opened the back door. The book was there! He had left it in the car after a (4)____ day at school. On Friday morning, Ben took the book to the library (5)____ time. The librarian smiled and said, 'Thank you (6)____ returning it on time.' Ben promised to be more (7)____ next time. (8)____ he got home, he put a small note in his bag to remind himself. Losing a book was not a big problem, (9)____ it taught Ben to take good care (10)____ the things he borrowed.

blanks.hint: 图书馆的书应按时归还。
在书桌里找用 look in the desk。
快到闭馆时间却找不到书，因而担心。
忙碌的一天后把书落在车里。
on time 表示准时。
Thank you for doing sth。
经历丢书后，决定以后更细心。
引导到家时这一时间状语从句。
问题不大，但从中学到道理，构成转折。
take good care of 表示好好照看。

items.hint: 按照寻找书本、按时归还和总结教训的顺序理解全文。

items.title: Grandma's Garden
items.passage: My grandmother has a small garden behind her house. She (1)____ it every morning before breakfast. In spring, she plants tomatoes, beans and sunflowers. I often help with the (2)____. At first, I thought gardening was boring, (3)____ now I enjoy it. Grandma says that plants need sunshine, water and (4)____. If we give them enough care, they will grow (5)____. Last summer, we picked a big basket of tomatoes. Grandma used some of them to make soup, and the soup tasted (6)____. She also gave some vegetables to our neighbours. They were very (7)____ to receive them. Working in the garden teaches me that good things take (8)____. It also helps me understand (9)____ food comes from. I am (10)____ to spend more time there with Grandma.

blanks.hint: 主语 she 为第三人称单数，一般现在时加 s。
with 后接名词，用动名词 watering。
原以为无聊，现在喜欢，表示转折。
与 sunshine、water 并列，用名词。
grow well 表示生长得好，用副词修饰 grow。
taste 是系动词，后接形容词。
be happy to 表示乐意或高兴做某事。
take time 表示需要时间。
come from 对应来源，问来自哪里。
be planning to do 表示正计划做某事。

items.hint: 从花园劳动、分享蔬菜和感悟三个层次理解短文。

items.title: A Rainy Football Match
items.passage: Our class had a football match last Saturday. In the morning, the sky was clear. By the time we (1)____ at the playground, however, it began to rain. Some players wanted to stop, (2)____ our captain said, 'We have practised for weeks. Let us keep playing!' We put on our raincoats and started the game. The ground was wet, so the ball moved (3)____ than usual. I fell down twice, but I did not (4)____ up. In the last five minutes, our captain passed the ball to me. I kicked it as (5)____ as I could. The ball flew past the goalkeeper and went into the net! Everyone shouted (6)____ excitement. After the match, we were tired and wet, (7)____ we were very proud. Our teacher told us that the rain had made the game more difficult, but it had also shown how (8)____ we could work together. Now I know that we should not be afraid of difficulties. We can (9)____ them when we face them with courage and (10)____.

blanks.hint: 故事发生在 last Saturday，用一般过去时。
有人想停，队长坚持比赛，表示转折。
than 前用 fast 的比较级。
did not 后接动词原形，give up 表示放弃。
as ... as 中间用形容词或副词原级。
with excitement 表示兴奋地。
又累又湿却感到自豪，形成转折。
修饰 work together，用副词 well。

At first, I thought the rule was unfair, (4)____ I agreed to try it for a week. The first two evenings were difficult. I kept reaching for my phone without thinking. The rule did not mean that we had to stop using phones. It simply reminded us to manage our time (6)____. Since then, I (7)____ a clear limit for daily screen time. items.title: The Class Trip to the Museum

It was hard work, (5)____ I enjoyed it. At the end of the trip, our teacher asked us to write down the most interesting thing we had learned. I wrote that history is not just about dates. It is about the lives of people who lived (6)____ us. I also understood that objects in a museum can tell (7)____ stories than books alone. Since the trip, I (8)____ more interested in history. items.title: The New Neighbour
items.passage: A new family moved into the house next door last month. They had a son named Leo, who was about my age. I had to knock on their door and ask for it. Leo opened the door and smiled. He found the ball and invited me to play with him. I soon discovered that he was friendly and had a good sense of (1)____. While we were playing, he told me that his family had moved because of his father's new job. He felt (2)____ because he did not know anyone here. I promised to introduce him to my friends. The next day, I invited him to join our football game. At first, he was a little (3)____, but our team welcomed him. After the game, we showed him the way to the library and the park. Moving to a new place can be difficult, (5)____ a friendly neighbour can make it easier. Since Leo arrived, our neighbourhood has become more (6)____. We often study or play together after school. I am glad that I stepped outside my comfort zone and said hello. Sometimes, the best friendships begin with a simple (7)____. Now I always try to welcome new classmates and neighbours. items.title: A Message from the Ocean

items.title: The Competition I Almost Quit
items.passage: Last year, I entered a public speaking competition for the first time. I worked hard on my speech for several weeks. However, on the morning of the competition, I woke up with a sore throat. My voice was so weak that I could hardly speak. I immediately thought about giving up. My mother made me some warm tea and asked me whether I would regret (1)____ if I did not try. I hesitated. I knew the answer was yes. When I arrived at the hall, I saw that the other speakers had practised even (2)____ than I had. My confidence fell. My name was called, and I walked to the front. For a few seconds, I forgot the first sentence. I took a deep breath and looked at my mother in the audience. Her calm smile reminded me that the goal was not to be perfect, but to do my best. I began to speak slowly. My voice was not strong, (3)____ my message was clear. When I finished, the audience clapped (4)____. I did not win first prize, but I did not finish last either. More importantly, I learned that fear is often (5)____ than the challenge itself. (6)____ I had given up, I would never have discovered that I could face such a situation. Since the competition, I (7)____ more confident when speaking in front of others. I have also joined the school debate club and volunteered (8)____ at a class meeting. I still feel nervous sometimes, but I no longer let fear make my decisions. If we wait until we feel completely ready, we may never (9)____. Courage does not mean we are not afraid; it means we act (10)____ our fear.

items.title: What I Learned from a Quiet Friend
items.passage: My friend Ethan almost never talks in class. For a long time, I thought he was uninterested in other people. One afternoon, I was sitting alone in the library because I had done badly in a maths test. Ethan came over and quietly placed a note beside my book. It said, 'Everyone has difficult days. You are not alone.' I was surprised, not only by the note, but also by the fact that he had noticed how I (1)____. I asked him how he had recognized my feelings so quickly. He said that he often sat quietly and watched people because it helped him understand (2)____ they needed. I realized that I had judged him (3)____. I had assumed that silence meant coldness, (4)____ it can actually show careful attention. After that day, Ethan and I began to meet after school. I did most of the talking, but he listened (5)____ and remembered details that others forgot. When I was worried, he did not always offer advice. Sometimes he simply stayed with me until I felt (6)____. His way of showing care was different, but it was just as (7)____ as a hug or a cheerful word. Since we became friends, I (8)____ to appreciate different ways of expressing kindness. I have also stopped making quick judgments about people who are quiet. items.hint: nearby 中的 ear 读 /ɪə(r)/；early、pearl、search 中的 ear 读 /ɜː(r)/。

items.hint: dogs 中的 s 读 /z/；books、cats、hats 中的 s 读 /s/。

items.question: 找出划线字母 s 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: books 中的 s 读 /s/；bags、rooms、beds 中的 s 读 /z/。

items.question: 找出划线字母 s 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: cups 中的 s 读 /s/；cars、flowers、apples 中的 s 读 /z/。

items.question: 找出划线字母 c 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: cake 中的 c 读 /k/；nice、dance、pencil 中的 c 读 /s/。

items.question: 找出划线字母 g 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: gift 中的 g 读 /ɡ/；orange、bridge、gentle 中的 g 读 /dʒ/。

items.question: 找出划线字母 g 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: giant 中的 g 读 /dʒ/；game、girl、give 中的 g 读 /ɡ/。

items.question: 找出划线字母 g 发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: gym 中的 g 读 /dʒ/；green、glass、grass 中的 g 读 /ɡ/。

items.hint: silent 中的 i 读 /aɪ/；minute、prison、dinner 中的 i 读 /ɪ/。

items.question: 找出划线字母 i 发音与其他三项不同的一项：

items.question: 找出划线字母 a 发音与其他三项不同的一项：

items.hint: candle 中的 a 读 /æ/；station、nation、famous 中的 a 读 /eɪ/。

items.question: 找出划线字母组合 ea 发音与其他三项不同的一项：

items.question: Please put the two ____ (box) beside the door.
items.hint: two 后接可数名词复数，box 的复数是 boxes。

items.question: Two ____ (baby) are sleeping in the next room.
items.hint: two 后接复数，baby 把 y 变 i 再加 es。

items.question: We can see five ____ (bus) at the station.
items.hint: five 后接可数名词复数，bus 的复数是 buses。

items.question: The farmer has six ____ (sheep) on the hill.
items.hint: six 后用复数，sheep 单复数同形。

items.question: My brother ____ (watch) the news every evening.
items.hint: every evening 表示习惯，单数主语后用 watches。

items.question: Our teacher ____ (teach) us English on Mondays.
items.hint: on Mondays 表示经常发生，单数主语后用 teaches。

items.question: Look! The dog is ____ (run) after a ball.
items.hint: Look 和 is 提示现在进行时，run 要双写 n 加 ing。

items.question: Listen! Someone is ____ (sing) in the classroom.
items.hint: Listen 和 is 提示正在发生，用 singing。

items.question: I ____ (clean) my room yesterday afternoon.
items.hint: yesterday afternoon 表示过去，谓语用 cleaned。

items.question: We ____ (visit) the science museum last Saturday.
items.hint: last Saturday 是过去时间，谓语用 visited。

items.question: This ruler is ____ (long) than that one.
items.hint: than 提示两者比较，用比较级 longer。

items.question: Of the three bags, the blue one is the ____ (small).
items.hint: of the three 和 the 提示三者比较，用最高级 smallest。

items.question: Today is my ____ (twelve) birthday; I am twelve years old.
items.hint: 生日序数用 twelfth 表示第十二个。

items.question: There are eight ____ (tomato) in the basket.
items.hint: eight 后用可数名词复数，tomato 的复数是 tomatoes。

items.question: The two ____ (child) are drawing a map together.
items.hint: two 后用复数，child 的不规则复数是 children。

items.question: My mother ____ (go) to work by bike every day.
items.hint: every day 表示习惯，单数主语后用 goes。

items.question: The students are ____ (write) cards for their teachers now.
items.hint: now 和 are 提示现在进行时，write 去 e 加 ing。

items.question: We ____ (have) a picnic by the lake last Sunday.
items.hint: last Sunday 表示过去，have 的过去式是 had。

items.question: The soup smells ____ (taste), so I want to try it.
items.hint: smells 在此是系动词，后接形容词 tasty 作表语。

items.question: Please speak ____ (quiet); the baby is asleep.
items.hint: 修饰动词 speak 要用副词 quietly。

items.question: Our new classmate is very ____ (friend) to everyone.
items.hint: is very 后需要形容词，friendly 表示友好的。

items.question: The sun is shining, and it is a ____ (sun) day.
items.hint: day 前需要形容词，sunny 表示晴朗的。

items.question: The little girl can dance ____ (beautiful).
items.hint: 修饰动词 dance 要用副词 beautifully。

items.question: My uncle is a ____ (farm); he grows rice.
items.hint: a 后需要表示人的单数名词，farmer 意为农民。

items.question: There are many ____ (leaf) on the ground in autumn.
items.hint: many 后接可数名词复数，leaf 的复数是 leaves。

items.question: The classroom is on the ____ (two) floor, above the first floor.
items.hint: 表示楼层顺序用序数词 second，即第二层。

items.question: The story made the children very ____ (happy).
items.hint: made the children 后用形容词作宾语补足语，very 修饰 happy。

items.question: The art room is ____ (big) than our classroom.
items.hint: than 表示两者比较，big 双写 g 加 er。

items.question: My father is a good ____ (cook); his noodles are delicious.
items.hint: a good 后需要单数名词，cook 在此意为厨师。

items.question: I brush my ____ (tooth) after breakfast and before bed.
items.hint: 刷牙指刷全部牙齿，用 tooth 的不规则复数 teeth。

items.question: The book is very ____ (use) for learning English words.
items.hint: is very 后用形容词 useful，表示有用的。

items.question: The boy is ____ (swim) in the pool at the moment.
items.hint: at the moment 和 is 提示现在进行时，swim 双写 m 加 ing。

items.question: We saw a lot of ____ (fish) in the river yesterday.
items.hint: a lot of 后接名词；这里笼统指河里的鱼，fish 单复数同形。

items.question: The ____ (nine) month of the year is September.
items.hint: 表示一年中的月份顺序用序数词 ninth。

items.question: My sister is a ____ (write) of stories for children.
items.hint: a 后要用表示人的单数名词 writer，意思是作家。

items.question: The boys played basketball ____ (happy) after school.
items.hint: 修饰动词短语 played basketball 用副词 happily。

items.question: This is the ____ (easy) question of all; everyone can answer it.
items.hint: of all 和 the 表示范围内最高级，easy 变为 easiest。

items.question: My father ____ (drive) me to school yesterday because it rained.
items.hint: yesterday 和 rained 表示过去，drive 的过去式是 drove。

items.question: The machine is checked ____ (regular) to keep it working safely.
items.hint: 修饰被动谓语 is checked 用副词 regularly，表示定期地。

items.question: The guide explained the rules ____ (clear) before we entered the lab.
items.hint: 修饰动词 explained 用副词 clearly，说明讲解的方式。

items.question: The museum is ____ (close) on Mondays, so we must go another day.
items.hint: 根据后句需改天去，系动词 is 后用 closed 表示关闭的。

items.question: The students were ____ (deep) moved by the volunteer's story.
items.hint: 修饰过去分词 moved 用副词 deeply，表示深深地感动。

items.question: The more ____ (care) you check your work, the fewer mistakes you will make.
items.hint: 空格修饰动词 check；the more carefully 构成越仔细就越少出错。

items.question: The bridge was ____ (complete) in 2020 and opened to traffic that year.
items.hint: 主语 bridge 承受完成这一动作，was 后用过去分词 completed 构成被动语态。

items.question: The old photos brought back ____ (value) memories of our school days.
items.hint: memories 前用形容词 valuable 修饰，表示珍贵的回忆。

items.question: The final ____ (choose) of the team will be made tomorrow.
items.hint: the final 后需要单数名词作主语，choice 表示选择。

items.question: The problem became even ____ (bad) after the heavy rain.
items.hint: even 修饰比较级；bad 的比较级是 worse。

items.question: Of all the runners in the final, Mei ran the ____ (fast).
items.hint: of all 限定比较范围，修饰 ran 用副词最高级 fastest。

items.question: The door must be ____ (lock) before the last person leaves.
items.hint: door 是被锁的对象，must be 后接过去分词 locked 构成被动语态。

items.question: The girl answered every question ____ (correct), so she won the quiz.
items.hint: 修饰动词 answered 用副词 correctly，表示答对了每一题。

items.question: The teacher spoke more ____ (slow) so that everyone could take notes.
items.hint: 空前已有 more，修饰动词 spoke 时用副词原级 slowly 构成比较级。

items.question: The new library has a large ____ (collect) of books about nature.
items.hint: a large 后需要单数名词，collection of books 表示藏书。

items.question: After a long ____ (discuss), the group agreed on a plan.
items.hint: a long 后接单数名词，discussion 表示讨论。

items.question: The ____ (develop) of the railway made travel between the towns easier.
items.hint: the 后及 of 前需要名词，development 表示发展。

items.question: The notice was ____ (write) in both Chinese and English.
items.hint: notice 是被写的，was 后用过去分词 written 构成被动语态。

items.question: The water in this bottle is ____ (little) than that in the other one.
items.hint: than 表示比较，修饰不可数名词 water 时 little 的比较级是 less。

items.question: The students listened in ____ (silent) while the results were announced.
items.hint: 介词 in 后接名词，in silence 表示安静地。

items.question: Her ____ (able) to solve problems helped the team finish the task.
items.hint: her 后需要名词；to solve problems 表明一种能力，用单数 ability。

items.question: The school has ____ (success) raised enough money to buy new books.
items.hint: 修饰谓语 has raised 用副词 successfully，表示成功地。

items.question: We were thankful for the doctor's ____ (kind) during the visit.
items.hint: 所有格 doctor's 后需要名词，kindness 表示善意。

items.question: This road is much ____ (wide) than it was ten years ago.
items.hint: much 和 than 提示比较级，wide 加 r 得 wider。

items.question: The speech was so ____ (power) that many listeners felt encouraged.
items.hint: was so 后接形容词；后文受到鼓舞说明演讲有感染力，用 powerful。

items.question: The trees along the river were ____ (plant) by local students last spring.
items.hint: trees 是被种植的，were 后接过去分词 planted。

items.question: The more we read, the ____ (much) we learn about the world.
items.hint: the more，the more 表示越读得多，了解得越多。

items.question: The answer was ____ (surprising) simple, even though the question looked difficult.
items.hint: 修饰形容词 simple 需要副词 surprisingly，表示出乎意料地简单。

items.question: The ____ (invent) of paper changed the way people shared ideas.
items.hint: the 和 of paper 构成名词短语，invention 指发明这一事物或过程。

items.question: The head teacher praised her for her ____ (honest) about the mistake.
items.hint: 物主代词 her 后需要名词，honesty 表示诚实。

items.question: This is the ____ (comfortable) chair in the room, according to everyone who tried it.
items.hint: in the room 表示范围，the 后需形容词最高级 most comfortable。

items.question: The speech has already been ____ (translate) into several languages.
items.hint: speech 是被翻译的，has been 后接过去分词构成现在完成时的被动语态。

items.question: He stared ____ (angry) at the broken window, but he said nothing.
items.hint: looked at 是看向，空格修饰动作 looked，用副词 angrily。

items.question: The ____ (important) of saving water was explained in the lesson.
items.hint: the 后和 of 前需要名词，importance 意为重要性。

items.question: Thanks to their hard work, the river is much ____ (clean) than before.
items.hint: much 和 than before 提示用比较级 cleaner。

items.question: All visitors are asked to wait ____ (patient) until the doors open.
items.hint: 修饰动词 wait 用副词 patiently，表示耐心等待。

items.question: The ____ (grow) of the young trees depends on enough sunlight and water.
items.hint: the 后和 of 前需要名词，growth 表示生长。

items.question: The medicine must be kept ____ (safe) away from young children.
items.hint: 空格修饰被动动作 be kept，safely away 表示安全地远离。

items.question: We were ____ (luck) enough to find the missing keys before it got dark.
items.hint: were 后需要形容词，结合及时找到钥匙的语境用 lucky。

items.question: Can you ____ the word “library” in English?
items.hint: say 强调说出的内容；speak 强调说某种语言；tell 常接听话的人；talk 指交谈。

items.question: My grandmother can ____ Chinese and a little English.
items.hint: speak 后可直接接语言；say 后接话语；tell 常接人；talk 指交谈。

items.question: Please ____ the story on page ten aloud.
items.hint: read 表示阅读文字；look 强调看；watch 强调观看；see 表示看见。

items.question: ____ at the picture and find the red bird.
items.hint: look at 表示看向；see 表示看见；watch 表示观看；read 表示阅读。

items.topic: find / look for / find out / look at
items.question: I can't find my key. Can you help me ____ it?
items.hint: look for 表示寻找；find out 表示查明；look at 表示看；look after 表示照顾。

items.topic: look after / look for / look at / look like
items.question: Please ____ the baby while I cook dinner.
items.hint: look after 表示照顾；look for 表示寻找；look at 表示看；look like 表示看起来像。

items.topic: wear / put on / dress / take off
items.question: It's cold outside. Please ____ your coat before you go out.
items.hint: put on 强调穿上的动作；take off 指脱下；dress 通常接人；wear 表示穿着的状态。

items.topic: wear / dress / put on / take off
items.question: Our teacher always ____ glasses, so we can recognize her easily.
items.hint: wears 表示戴着的状态；puts on 是戴上的动作；dresses 通常接人；takes off 表示摘下。

items.question: There isn't ____ milk in the fridge. Let's buy some.
items.hint: 否定句中 any 可修饰不可数名词 milk；many、a few 和 a number of 修饰可数名词复数。

items.topic: how much / how many / how old / how long
items.question: — ____ eggs do we need for the cake? — Three.
items.hint: how many 询问可数名词数量；how much 问价格或不可数数量；how old 问年龄；how long 问时长或长度。

items.topic: how much / how many / how often / how far
items.question: — ____ is this notebook? — It's six yuan.
items.hint: how much 可询问价格；how many 问数量；how often 问频率；how far 问距离。

items.question: Our art lesson starts ____ eight o'clock on Friday.
items.hint: 具体时刻前用 at；in 常接月份或年份；on 常接具体日期；for 常表示持续时间或目的。

items.question: We usually have a class meeting ____ Monday afternoon.
items.hint: 具体某一天的下午前用 on；in 常用于泛指下午；at 用于时刻；by 可表示不迟于。

items.question: The library is ____ the bank and the post office.
items.hint: between A and B 表示在两者之间；among 表示在一群人或物中；across 和 through 表示穿过。

items.question: Walk ____ the bridge to the other side of the river.
items.hint: across 强调从表面一端到另一端；through 强调穿过内部；along 表示沿着；into 表示进入。

items.question: The road is wet ____ it rained heavily last night.
items.hint: because 引出原因；so 引出结果；but 表转折；or 表选择或否则。

items.question: The soup looks good, ____ it tastes too salty.
items.hint: 前后意思转折，用 but；and 表并列；or 表选择；because 引出原因。

items.question: Would you like rice ____ noodles for lunch? Choose one.
items.hint: 选择疑问句中用 or 连接供选择的事物；and 表并列；but 表转折；so 表结果。

items.question: ____ are my shoes here, and those are yours over there.
items.hint: these 指近处的复数事物；this 指近处单数；that 指远处单数；it 代指单数事物。

items.question: I have two pens. One is black; ____ is blue.
items.hint: 两者中另一个用 the other；another 指另一个但不限定两者；other 修饰名词；others 泛指其他人或物。

items.question: There are only two doors. ____ door has a number on it.
items.hint: each 可单独修饰单数名词，强调每一个；both、all、many 在此不能直接修饰单数 door。

items.question: The bottle is empty. There is ____ water in it.
items.hint: empty 表明没有水，用 no；some 表示一些；much 和 a lot of 表示许多。

items.question: I ____ walk to school: I do it once or twice a month.
items.hint: 每月一两次表示有时，用 sometimes；always 总是；never 从不；usually 通常。

items.question: The science show is ____. It makes the children want to learn more.
items.hint: interesting 描述事物有趣；interested 描述人感兴趣；interest 可作名词或动词；interests 是其复数或第三人称单数形式。

items.question: The children are ____ about their first visit to the zoo.
items.hint: excited 描述人的感受；exciting 描述令人兴奋的事物；excite 是动词；excitement 是名词。

items.question: Please be ____ in the library; people are reading.
items.hint: quiet 意为安静的；quite 意为相当；quick 意为快的；quickly 是快速地。

items.question: My father has a new ____ at a hospital. He is a nurse.
items.hint: a new 后需要单数可数名词 job，表示工作岗位；work 作工作讲通常不可数；worker 是工人；works 不能用于此处。

items.question: After school, I go ____ and have dinner with my parents.
items.hint: go home 表示回家，home 作副词；house 指房屋，family 指家庭，room 指房间，三者不能直接这样接在 go 后。

items.question: Some students draw pictures; ____ students make cards.
items.hint: other 修饰后面的复数名词 students；others 单独使用；another 接单数；the other one 单独指另一人或物。

items.question: My old schoolbag is broken, so I need to buy a new ____ .
items.hint: one 代替前面提到的同类单数物品；it 指同一个；this 和 that 不能接在 a new 后作此替代。

items.topic: every day / everyday / every year / one day
items.question: I brush my teeth twice ____: once in the morning and once before bed.
items.hint: every day 表示每天；everyday 是形容词，意为日常的；every year 每年；one day 某一天。

items.question: The children are washing ____ hands before lunch.
items.hint: their 是形容词性物主代词，修饰 hands；there 表示那里；they're 是 they are；them 是宾格。

items.question: — ____ jacket is this? — It's my brother's.
items.hint: whose 询问所属；who 问人；where 问地点；when 问时间。

items.question: — ____ color is your schoolbag? — Blue.
items.hint: what color 询问颜色；how 问方式或状况；where 问地点；when 问时间。

items.question: Mia got an invitation, but she could not ____ it because she had an exam that day.

items.question: Scientists ____ a new island after the volcano appeared above the sea.
items.hint: discover 指发现已经存在的事物；invent 指发明；create 指创造；produce 指生产。

items.question: Who ____ the telephone? — Alexander Graham Bell did.

items.question: The ____ of the meeting is to choose a leader for the team.
items.hint: purpose 是目的；result 是结果；reason 是原因；method 是方法。to choose 表明会议目的。

items.question: As a ____ of the heavy rain, the game was put off.
items.hint: as a result of 表示由于；cause 原因；choice 选择；method 方法，后三者不构成此短语。

items.question: You won't enter the lab ____ you wear safety glasses. They are required for everyone.
items.hint: unless 表示除非，强调戴护目镜是进入的必要条件；although 表让步；because 表原因；so 表结果。

items.question: My sister has studied French ____ she moved to Canada in 2022.
items.hint: since 后接过去某一时间或时间从句，与现在完成时搭配；for 接时间段；during 接名词；until 表直到。

items.question: They have known each other ____ more than ten years.
items.hint: for 后接持续时间；since 后接起点；during 表在某段时间内；from 表起点，通常与 to 连用。

items.topic: as a result / for example / in fact / at first
items.question: The road was covered with ice. ____, the bus arrived two hours late.
items.hint: as a result 引出结果；for example 举例；in fact 表实际上；at first 表起初。

items.question: We didn't go swimming. We played table tennis ____ .
items.hint: instead 可单独放句末，表示作为替代；instead of 后接被替代的对象；besides 表此外；except 表除去。

items.question: We used the stairs ____ the lift because the lift was broken.
items.hint: instead of 表示用楼梯代替电梯；because of 表因为；in front of 表在前面；in need of 表需要。

items.question: The two bags look ____, but their sizes are not exactly the same.

items.question: The doctor ____ me to drink more water and get enough sleep.
items.hint: advise sb to do 表示建议某人做；suggest 通常不接 sb to do；make 和 let 后接动词原形。

items.question: The school sports meeting will ____ on the playground next Friday, as planned.

items.topic: used to / be used to / be used for / use
items.question: My grandfather ____ walk to work, but now he drives there.

items.question: The little bird was still ____ after the storm, so we took it to a safe place.
items.hint: alive 作表语表示活着；lively 表活泼；live 常作前置定语表示活的；livingly 不符合此处用法。

items.question: The flowers are ____. Give them some water before it's too late.
items.hint: dying 表示正在枯死，符合还来得及浇水；dead 表已死；death 是名词；die 是动词原形。

items.question: The dog slept ____ the fireplace, close enough to feel its warmth.

items.hint: through 表示穿过窗户进入；across 表从一边到另一边；under 表在下方；between 表在两者之间。

items.hint: in 加时间段用于将来，表示多久之后；for 表持续；since 表起点；during 后接名词短语。

items.question: Please return the form ____ Friday; any day before then is fine.

items.question: We haven't decided ____ to go by bus or by train.

items.hint: affect 作动词表示影响；effect 通常作名词表示影响或效果；effort 是努力；afford 表负担得起。

items.question: The flight was delayed ____ the thick fog at the airport.
items.hint: because of 后接名词短语；because 和 although 后接句子；so 连接结果分句。

items.topic: used for / used to / used by / used as
items.question: A dictionary is ____ finding the meanings of words.

items.question: I ____ walking to driving when the weather is pleasant.

items.question: Our class plans ____ trees near the river next week.

items.question: I hope ____ my grandparents during the holiday.
items.hint: hope to do 表示希望做某事。

items.question: You need ____ your hands before dinner.

items.question: I would love ____ your new puppy after school.

items.question: My brother enjoys ____ pictures of animals.
items.hint: enjoy 后接动词-ing 形式，表示喜欢做某事。

items.question: Please finish ____ your room before lunch.
items.hint: finish 后接动词-ing 形式，表示完成某事。

items.question: Linda practises ____ the piano for half an hour daily.
items.hint: practise 后接动词-ing 形式，表示练习做某事。

items.hint: mind 后接动词-ing 形式，表示介意做某事。

items.hint: 介词 for 后用动词-ing 形式，thank somebody for doing 表示感谢某人做了某事。

items.question: Tom is good at ____ stories to young children.
items.hint: 介词 at 后接动词-ing，be good at doing 表示擅长做某事。

items.question: My classmates are interested in ____ about space.
items.hint: 介词 in 后接动词-ing，表示对做某事感兴趣。

items.question: What about ____ a photo of the whole team?
items.hint: What about 后接动词-ing，用来提出建议。

items.question: How about ____ the rest of the cake with our friends?
items.hint: How about 后接动词-ing，用来提出建议。

items.question: Our dog loves ____ in the garden when music is playing.

items.question: Please let me ____ the heavy bag for you.

items.question: Why not ____ a map before we start our trip?
items.hint: Why not 后接动词原形，用来提出建议。

items.question: You had better ____ a coat; it is cold outside.
items.hint: had better 后接动词原形，表示最好做某事。

items.question: We have to ____ quiet in the library.
items.hint: have to 后接动词原形，表示不得不做某事。

items.question: Mum wants me ____ some milk on my way home.
items.hint: want somebody to do 表示想让某人做某事。

items.question: Jack invited us ____ his kite in the park.
items.hint: invite somebody to do 表示邀请某人做某事。

items.question: My aunt taught me ____ dumplings last weekend.
items.hint: teach somebody to do 表示教某人做某事。

items.question: We often go ____ at the pool on hot days.

items.question: After ____ his teeth, Ben went to bed.
items.hint: after 在此是介词，后接动词-ing，表示刷牙之后。

items.question: Please turn off the computer before ____ the room.
items.hint: before 在此是介词，后接动词-ing，表示离开之前。

items.hint: It's time to do 表示到了做某事的时间。

items.question: I went to the shop ____ some bread for breakfast.

items.question: The parcel is still here. Please remember ____ it to the post office today.

items.question: I remember ____ the door; I checked that it was locked before leaving.
items.hint: 已经检查过门锁好了，remember doing 表示记得做过某事。

items.question: The plants are dry because I forgot ____ them yesterday.
items.hint: 植物干了，说明昨天忘记浇水；forget to do 指忘记要做某事。

items.hint: that day 指过去发生的领奖经历，forget doing 表示忘记做过某事。

items.question: The baby finally fell asleep, so everyone stopped ____ in the hall.
