items.question: After walking for two hours, we stopped ____ some water.
items.hint: 走了两小时后停下来喝水，stop to do 表示停下原来的事去做另一件事。

items.question: The room feels hot. Try ____ the fan and see if it helps.
items.hint: 建议用风扇试试看效果，try doing 表示尝试某种办法。

items.question: The box was heavy, but the boy tried ____ it onto the shelf.
items.hint: 箱子很重，男孩努力把它抬上架子，try to do 强调努力做某事。

items.question: We regret ____ you that tomorrow's match has been cancelled.
items.hint: regret to tell 表示遗憾地告知接下来的消息。

items.question: She regretted ____ angry words to her friend and later said sorry.
items.hint: 道歉说明伤人的话已经说过，regret doing 表示后悔做过某事。

items.question: There used to ____ a small bridge here, but it is gone now.
items.hint: used to do 表示过去常有或曾经存在，后接动词原形。

items.question: The new student is now used to ____ lunch at school.
items.hint: be used to doing 表示习惯做某事，to 是介词，后接动词-ing。

items.question: This knife is used ____ fruit into small pieces.
items.hint: be used to do 在此表示被用来做某事，说明小刀的用途。

items.question: The children look forward to ____ their new science teacher.
items.hint: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接动词-ing，表示期待做某事。

items.question: Please pay attention to ____ the words clearly in your speech.
items.hint: pay attention to 中的 to 是介词，后接动词-ing，表示注意做某事。

items.question: I prefer ____ books from the library to watching videos at home.
items.hint: prefer doing A to doing B 表示相比做 B 更喜欢做 A。

items.question: The players were made ____ the rules again after breaking them.
items.hint: make somebody do 变为被动语态后，通常用 be made to do。

items.question: The bird was seen ____ into the house through the open window.
items.hint: see somebody do 表示看见动作全过程；变为被动时用 be seen to do。

items.question: The old bridge needs ____ before cars can cross it again.
items.hint: 桥需要被修理，need to be done 表示需要被做；不定式的被动式突出桥是承受动作的一方。

items.question: The soup is too hot for the baby ____ now.
items.hint: too ... to do 表示太……而不能做某事。

items.question: The shelf is low enough for the child ____ without a chair.
items.hint: 形容词后接 enough to do，表示足够……而能够做某事。

items.question: We haven't decided where ____ the school art show.
items.hint: where 后接不定式可作 decided 的宾语，表示在哪里举办。

items.question: The guide showed us how ____ tickets on the machine.
items.hint: how 后接不定式，表示如何订票。

items.question: I can't decide which book ____ for the book report.
items.hint: which book 后接不定式，表示选择哪本书。

items.question: ____ enough sleep helps teenagers stay healthy.
items.hint: 动词-ing 形式作主语，表示获得充足睡眠这件事。

items.question: He left the meeting without ____ goodbye to anyone.
items.hint: without 是介词，后接动词-ing，表示没有做某事。

items.question: You can improve your pronunciation by ____ to English recordings.
items.hint: by 后接动词-ing，表示通过某种方式。

items.question: Instead of ____ a taxi, they walked to the station.
items.hint: instead of 后接动词-ing，表示没有乘出租车而选择步行。

items.question: She succeeded in ____ the difficult puzzle on her own.
items.hint: succeed in doing 表示成功做某事，介词 in 后接动词-ing。

items.question: To save water, avoid ____ the tap running while brushing your teeth.
items.hint: avoid 后接动词-ing，表示避免做某事。

items.question: The doctor suggested ____ a short walk after dinner.
items.hint: suggest 后接动词-ing，表示建议做某事。

items.question: The long wait kept the visitors ____ outside in the rain.
items.hint: keep somebody doing 表示使某人持续处于做某事的状态。

items.question: I heard someone ____ next door when I was doing my homework.
items.hint: 做作业时听到隔壁有人正在唱歌，hear somebody doing 强调听到正在进行的动作。

items.question: I noticed the boy ____ the wallet and hand it to the teacher.
items.hint: notice somebody do 可以表示注意到完整动作，与后面的 hand 并列。

items.question: We left home early ____ the first bus to the zoo.
items.hint: to catch 表示早出门的目的：赶上第一班车。

items.question: The sign warns visitors not ____ the animals in the zoo.
items.hint: warn somebody not to do 表示警告某人不要做某事。

items.question: The teacher explained when ____ in our reports.
items.hint: when 后接不定式，表示何时上交报告。

items.question: It was kind of you ____ my grandmother across the road.
items.hint: It is kind of somebody to do 用形容词描述人的品质，不定式是真正的主语。

items.question: I have a letter ____ before the post office closes.
items.hint: 不定式 to write 作后置定语，表示有一封信要写。

items.question: We couldn't help ____ when the actor slipped on a banana skin.
items.hint: can't help doing 表示忍不住做某事。

调整动作是为了让寻找玩具的情节更明显。
请几位低年级学生观看并反馈理解情况。
观众反馈帮助他们进一步修改表演。
孩子们理解故事，并为有趣的结尾发笑。
创作者可能忽略的问题，观众反馈可以揭示出来。
这些调整帮助演员把故事讲得更清楚。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 ar 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: warm 中 ar 读 /ɔː/；car、park、star 中 ar 读 /ɑː/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 or 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: word 中 or 读 /ɜː/；fork、short、sport 中 or 读 /ɔː/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 ur 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: bury 中 ur 读 /e/；turn、burn、hurt 中 ur 读 /ɜː/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 oa 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: broad 中 oa 读 /ɔː/；boat、coat、road 中 oa 读 /əʊ/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 ai 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: said 中 ai 读 /e/；rain、train、wait 中 ai 读 /eɪ/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 ay 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: says 中 ay 读 /e/；day、play、stay 中 ay 读 /eɪ/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 ie 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: tie 中 ie 读 /aɪ/；piece、field、thief 中 ie 读 /iː/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 igh 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: eight 中 igh 读 /eɪ/；light、night、right 中 igh 读 /aɪ/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 wh 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: who 中 wh 读 /h/；what、when、which 中 wh 读 /w/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 gh 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: high 中 gh 不发音；laugh、cough、rough 中 gh 读 /f/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 ch 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: chef 中 ch 读 /ʃ/；chair、choose、cheese 中 ch 读 /tʃ/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 au 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: 按英式发音，aunt 中 au 读 /ɑː/；author、August、autumn 中 au 读 /ɔː/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 al 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: 按英式发音，half 中 al 读 /ɑː/；talk、walk、wall 中 al 读 /ɔː/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 ew 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: 按英式发音，crew 中 ew 读 /uː/；new、few、news 中 ew 读 /juː/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 oo 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: blood 中 oo 读 /ʌ/；pool、spoon、tooth 中 oo 读 /uː/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母 s 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: basic 中所标的 s 读 /s/；music、visit、reason 中所标的 s 读 /z/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母 x 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: exam 中 x 读 /ɡz/；box、six、next 中 x 读 /ks/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出单词中所标字母组合 tion 的发音与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: question 中 tion 读 /tʃən/；station、nation、action 中 tion 读 /ʃən/。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出重音位置与其他三项不同的一项：
items.hint: happen /ˈhæpən/ 重音在第一音节；begin /bɪˈɡɪn/、enjoy /ɪnˈdʒɔɪ/、decide /dɪˈsaɪd/ 的重音均在第二音节。

items.question: 按英式发音，选出与 sea 同音的一项：
items.hint: sea 和 see 都读 /siː/；say /seɪ/、she /ʃiː/、sky /skaɪ/ 与其不同。

items.question: Mia made the birthday card by ____ (she), without any help.
items.hint: by oneself 表示独自完成；Mia 是女性，用 herself。

items.topic: 名词所有格与共同拥有
items.question: Lily and Lucy share one bedroom. This is Lily and ____ (Lucy) bedroom.
items.hint: 两人共同拥有一个房间时，只在最后一个名字后加所有格：Lily and Lucy’s。

items.topic: 不规则复数与成对物品
items.question: The old man needs two new ____ (knife) for the kitchen.
items.hint: two 后需要名词复数；knife 的复数是 knives。

items.question: I have never ____ (see) snow, so I hope to visit Harbin.
items.hint: have never 后接过去分词，see 的过去分词是 seen。

items.question: March 8 is Women’s Day; it falls on the ____ (eight) day of March.
items.hint: 表示一个月的第几天，用序数词；eight 的序数词是 eighth。

items.topic: 复合名词中的名词复数
items.question: The hospital has several ____ (woman) doctors who care for children.
items.hint: woman 作定语修饰复数 doctors 时也要变复数，women doctors 意为女医生。

items.question: We invited six families, and all six ____ (invite) were accepted.
items.hint: all six 后需要可数名词复数；invite 的名词复数为 invitations。

items.question: The answer cannot be right: 2 plus 2 is 4, not 5. It is ____ (correct).
items.hint: 算式 2 + 2 = 5 是错误的；is 后用形容词 incorrect。

items.topic: 名词变形容词与后置定语
items.question: Do you have anything ____ (salt) to eat? I do not want anything sweet.
items.hint: anything 后可用形容词作后置定语；与 sweet 相对，用 salty。

items.topic: 名词变动词与情态动词
items.question: The bag is too heavy for me. Could you ____ (weight) it for me?
items.hint: 情态动词 could 后接动词原形；weight 对应的动词是 weigh，意为称重。

items.topic: 动词变名词与固定结构
items.question: To our ____ (amaze), the tiny seed grew into a tall tree.
items.hint: to one’s amazement 意为令某人惊讶的是，物主代词后用名词 amazement。

items.question: The box has a ____ (long) of 30 cm, a width of 20 cm and a height of 10 cm.
items.hint: a 后需要单数名词；length 指长度，与 width、height 并列。

items.question: Please hold the rope ____ (tight); do not let it move.
items.hint: hold tight 表示握紧，tight 在这里用作副词；没有比较对象，不能用 tighter。

items.question: Thank you for ____ (lend) me your bike yesterday.
items.hint: 介词 for 后用动名词 lending，yesterday 说明动作发生的时间。

items.question: The glass is ____ (break), so do not drink from it.
items.hint: is 后用 broken 表示杯子处于破损状态；后句说明不能用它喝水。

items.topic: 副词比较级与动作方式
items.question: Ben made fewer mistakes than Tom. He spelled the words more ____ (accurate) than Tom.
items.hint: 空格修饰动词 spelled，more 已给出，填副词原级 accurately 构成比较级。

items.question: The twins built the model planes ____ (they); nobody helped them.
items.hint: nobody helped them 表明是双胞胎亲自完成；复数反身代词用 themselves。

items.topic: 形容词反义词与否定前缀
items.question: The road is covered with ice, so it is ____ (safe) to ride a bike on it.
items.hint: 冰覆盖路面，结合骑车的语境，is 后用形容词 unsafe 表示不安全。

items.topic: 现在分词与不定代词修饰
items.question: There is nothing ____ (worry) about: the doctor says the test result is normal.
items.hint: nothing 后用形容词 worrying 作后置定语，表示没有令人担心的事。

items.topic: 被动语态与不规则过去分词
items.question: This song was ____ (sing) in English by our whole class at the party.
items.hint: 主语 song 是被唱的，was 与过去分词 sung 构成一般过去时的被动语态。

items.question: The doctor gave me a useful piece of ____ about getting enough sleep.
items.hint: a piece of advice 意为“一条建议”；advice 是不可数名词，advise 是动词。

items.question: The book costs 30 yuan. Its ____ is printed on the back cover.
items.hint: price 指价格；prize 指奖品，praise 指赞扬，pride 指自豪。

items.question: Please speak in a louder ____. I cannot hear your words at the back of the room.
items.hint: voice 指人说话或唱歌的声音；noise 常指噪声，sound 泛指声音。这里 louder voice 与说话的语境相符。

items.question: I am not sure, but ____ we can visit the museum on Saturday.
items.hint: maybe 是副词，表示“也许”，可放在句首修饰整个句子；may be 是情态动词加动词原形。

items.topic: sometime / some time / sometimes / some times
items.question: We have not chosen a date, but we plan to meet ____ next week.
items.hint: sometime 表示某个不确切的时间；some time 表示一段时间，sometimes 表示有时，some times 表示几次。

items.question: We ____ the airport at 7 a.m. and checked in for our flight.
items.hint: reach 是及物动词，可直接接地点；arrive at 和 get to 接地点时需要介词。

items.question: I got a letter from my pen friend yesterday. It was great to ____ her again.
items.hint: hear from sb 表示收到某人的来信或消息；hear of 和 hear about 表示听说。

items.topic: look forward to / look up to
items.question: The children are ____ the school trip next Friday; they talk about it every day.
items.hint: look forward to 表示期待；look after 是照顾，look down on 是瞧不起，look up 可表示查阅或向上看。

items.question: The music is too loud. Could you please ____ the volume so I can study?
items.hint: turn down the volume 表示调低音量；turn up 调高音量，turn on 打开，turn into 变成。

items.question: The joke was so ____ that everyone in the room laughed.
items.hint: funny 作形容词表示滑稽可笑的；fun 在此作名词表示乐趣，不能用 so 修饰并作表语。

items.question: Dad called while you were out. He left a ____ asking you to call him back.
items.hint: leave a message 表示留口信；news、information 和 advice 一般是不可数名词，不能直接与 a 连用。

items.question: We walked ____ the bakery without stopping and entered the bank next door.
items.hint: walk past 表示走过；passed 是动词 pass 的过去式，不能直接跟在已作谓语的 walked 后。

items.question: I got to the bus stop at 8:05, but the last bus had left at 8:00. I ____ it.
items.hint: miss a bus 指没赶上车；lose 表示丢失，catch a bus 表示赶上车。

items.question: These shoes are the right size. They ____ me well.
items.hint: fit 表示尺寸适合某人；match 常表示颜色或样式相配。

items.question: The soup ____ salty because I put too much salt in it.
items.hint: salty 描述咸味，taste salty 表示尝起来咸；smell 表示闻起来，sound 表示听起来，look 表示看起来。

items.question: The library is ____ now; no one is talking or making a sound.
items.hint: quiet 是形容词，表示安静的；quite 是副词，表示相当；quick 是迅速的。

items.question: It was raining. ____, the children still went outside to play.
items.hint: However 可作副词引出转折，后面可用逗号；although、because 和 unless 通常引导从句。

items.topic: at the end / in the end
items.question: We tried several ways to solve the problem. ____, we found the answer.
items.hint: in the end 表示最后、终于，可单独使用；at the end of 和 by the end of 后面需要接名词。

items.question: After months of practice, the team finally ____ in reaching the top of the mountain.
items.hint: succeed in doing sth 表示成功做成某事；success 是名词，successful 是形容词，successfully 是副词。

items.question: Please ____ the bottle with water before we leave.
items.hint: fill ... with ... 表示用……装满；full 是形容词，常用于 be full of。

items.question: The doctor advised Dad to give up ____ because it was bad for his health.
items.hint: give up 后接动名词；give up smoking 表示戒烟。

items.question: Although it was raining, the runners kept on ____ until they reached the finish line.
items.hint: keep on 后接动名词，表示继续做某事。

items.question: Seeing my hands were full, Amy offered ____ the door for me.
items.hint: offer to do 表示主动提出做某事，offer 后接不定式。

items.question: The boy refused ____ the medicine because he thought it tasted terrible.
items.hint: refuse to do 表示拒绝做某事，refuse 后接不定式。

items.question: I promised ____ my library book tomorrow, so someone else can read it.
items.hint: promise to do 表示答应做某事，promise 后接不定式。

items.question: The heavy rain stopped us from ____ the mountain that morning.
items.hint: stop somebody from doing 表示阻止某人做某事，介词 from 后用动名词。

items.question: I had trouble ____ asleep last night because of the noise outside.
items.hint: have trouble doing 表示做某事有困难，trouble 后接动名词。

items.question: She spent twenty minutes ____ for her missing glasses under the bed.
items.hint: spend 时间 doing 表示花时间做某事，时间后接动名词。

items.question: The fence prevents the little dog from ____ into the street.
items.hint: prevent somebody from doing 表示阻止某人做某事，from 后接动名词。

items.question: Our school allows students ____ books from the library for two weeks.
items.hint: allow somebody to do 表示允许某人做某事，宾语 students 后接不定式。

items.question: We expected the bus ____ at nine, but it arrived ten minutes late.
items.hint: expect somebody or something to do 表示预计某人或某物会做某事。

items.question: The coach encouraged the team ____ again after they lost the first game.
items.hint: encourage somebody to do 表示鼓励某人做某事，宾语后接不定式。

items.question: The book is worth ____ because it tells the story in a clear way.
items.hint: be worth doing 表示值得做某事，用主动形式的动名词表达被动含义。

items.question: The class is ready ____ the game as soon as the teacher gives the signal.
items.hint: be ready to do 表示准备好做某事，ready 后接不定式。

items.question: I was surprised ____ my old friend at the station yesterday.
items.hint: be surprised to do 表示因做某事而感到惊讶，此处见到老朋友使我吃惊。

items.question: Students are allowed ____ their own books during the reading class.
items.hint: 主动式为 allow somebody to do；改成被动式后仍保留 to do。

items.question: My brother did not use to ____ breakfast, but now he eats it every day.
items.hint: did not use to 后接动词原形，表示过去没有某种习惯；此处 to 已在题干中。

items.question: In order not ____ the baby, Dad closed the door quietly.
items.hint: in order not to do 表示为了不做某事，not 放在不定式 to 前面。

items.question: There are enough chairs for every student ____ on during the show.
items.hint: enough 加名词后可用 for somebody to do 说明用途；sit on 后的宾语是前面的 chairs。

items.topic: have no choice but to do
items.question: The road was closed, so we had no choice but ____ another way home.
items.hint: have no choice but to do 表示别无选择，只能做某事；but 后接带 to 的不定式。
